text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: En èster un estat en eth quau eth guanhador ac arrecep tot, Florida assignèc es sòns cinquanta delegadi a Rommey, en tot possar-lo coma principau candidat entara nominacion deth Partit Republican.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Es organizadors dera manifestacion an afirmat qu'ath torn d'ues 100 000 persones participèren en ciutats d'Alemanha coma Berlin, Colònia, Amborg e Hannòver.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Era policia calculèc 6500 manifestants en Berlin.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Es manifestacions aueren lòc, ath delà, en París; Sofia, Bulgaria; Vilnius, Lituània; Valetta, Malta; Tallin, Estònia, Edimborg, Glasgow e Escòcia.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: En Londres, ath torn d'ues 200 persones se manifestèren dehòra des burèus de bèri des proprietaris de drets d'autor mès importants.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Eth mes passat s'amièren a tèrme importantes manifestacions en Polonha quan eth país signèc era ACTA, çò qu'a possat ath govèrn polonés a préner era decision de non ratificar er acòrd, peth moment.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Autant Letònia coma Eslovaquia an ajornat eth procediment d'incorporacion ara ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Eth moviment Desliurança Animau e era Reau Societat entara Prevencion dera Crueltat contra es Animaus (RSPCA) nauament reclamen era installacion obligatòria de camères de videovigilància en toti es auciders d'Austràlia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: David, O'Shannessy, inspector cap dera RSPCA de New South Wales, afirmèc ara ABC qu'en Austràlia aurie d'èster ua practica normau sométer a vigilància e inspeccion as auciders.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: «En installar un circuït barrat de television, se garantís er enviament d'un messatge contondent entad aqueri que trabalhen damb animaus, qu'eth sòn benèster ei de prioritat maxima».
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Eth mapa internacionau de tèrratrems deth Servici Geologic d'EE. UU. non mostrèc moviments sismics en Islàndia era setmana anteriora.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Tanpòc eth Burèu Meteorologic d'Islàndia reportèc activitat sismica en Hekla pendent es darrères 48 ores.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Era significant activitat sismica, resultat deth cambi de fasa, s'auie produsit eth 10 de març ena cara nòrd-orientau dera caudèra deth volcan.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: S'enregistrèren bromes escures ena basa dera montanha sense relacion damb cap activitat volcanica.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Es bromes podien potenciaument generar confusion sus se reaument i auie agut ua vertadèra erupcion.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Quan se produsic era pana, eth Luno amiaue 120-160 mètres cubics de combustible a bòrd e es vents fòrts e es ondes lo possèren contra er espigon.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Es elicoptèrs rescatèren as dotze membres dera tripulacion, e era unica lesion siguec ua fractura de nas.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Eth vaishèth de 100 mètres ère en rota entà arremassar era sua carga abituau de fertilizants e, en un començament, i auie preocupacion entre es foncionaris per se se podesse quèir bèra carga.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Andues crambes aprovèren era esmenda prepausada en 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Pendent aguesta session legislativa s'introdusic ua modificacion quan era Cramba de Representants eliminèc era dusau frasa e dempús eth Senat ac aprovèc de manèra similara eth deluns.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Existís era possibilitat de qu'era eliminacion dera dusau frasa, que prepause proïbir es unions civius entre individus deth madeish sèxe, daurisque era pòrta as unions civius en futur.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: En tot seguir eth procès, HJR-3 serà examinat un còp mès per part dera naua legislatura electa, en 2015 o 2016.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Es assolidatges de Vautier, sense compdar eth sòn papèr de director, includissen ua grèva de hame en 1973 entà lutar contra çò qu'eth vedie coma censura politica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Era lei francesa siguec modificada. S'inicièc coma activista ara edat de 15 ans, en integrar-se ara Resisténcia Francesa pendent era Dusau Guèrra Mondiau.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Escriuec un libre autobiografic en 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: En decènni de 1960, tornèc tà Argelia, qu'artenhec era sua independéncia recentament, entà dar classes de direccion cinematografica.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Eth judòca de Japon, Hitoshi Saito, guanhador de dues medalhes olimpiques d'aur, moric as 54 ans.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Se comuniquèc qu'era causa dera mòrt siguec càncer intraepatic deth conducte biliar.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Moric eth dimars en Osaka.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: En moment dera sua mòrt, ath delà d'auer estat medalhista olimpic e mondiau, Saito ère eth director deth comitat d'entrenament dera Federacion de Judo japonesa.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Aumens 100 convidadi auien assistit ara hèsta tà celebrar eth prumèr anniversari d'ua parelha que s'auie maridat est’an passat.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Es autoritats informèren que se programèc un eveniment formau d'anniversari entà ua auta data posteriora.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Era parelha s'auie maridat en Texas un an abans e arribèren a Buffalo entà hestejà'c damb es sòns amics e familhaus.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Eth marit, de 30 ans e neishut en Buffalo, a estat un des quate mòrts en tiroteig, mès era sua hemna non patic lesions.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ei un arreconeishut, encara que controvertit, professor d'anglés qu'impartie classes enes escòles Modern Education e en King's Glory e qu'assegurèc auer agut 9000 alumnes en pic dera sua carrera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Enes nòtes utilizaue mots que quauqui pairs credien qu'èren grossièrs e, d'acòrd as informes, utilizèc, ath delà, mots pòc adequats pendent es classes.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education l'acusèc per publicar grani anoncis publicitaris enes autobusi sense èster autorizat e per mentir en díder qu'ère eth professor d'anglés mès important.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Tanben se li culpèc en passat per violacion de drets d'autor, mès non siguec acusat.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un antic estudiant didec qu'er òme «auie utilizat argòt enes classes, ensenhaue abiletats entà usar pendent es cites damb nòtes, e actuaue coma se siguesse amic des alumnes».
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Pendent es darrèri tres decènnis, China a desvolopat ua economia de mercat, encara que, oficiaument, contunhe en tot auer un règim comunista.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Jos eth comandament de Deng Xiaoping s'introdusiren es prumères reformes economiques.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: D'alavetz ençà, eth nivèu economic de China a creishut 90 còps.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: En çò que tanh ara exportacion d'automobils, China superèc, per prumèr còp, a Alemanha e auancèc a EE. UU. coma eth mercat mès important d'aguesta indústria.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: En vint ans, eth PIB de China poderie èster mès naut qu'eth des Estats Units.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Laguens dera sason d'auragans der Atlantic de 2010, Danielle ei era quatau tempèsta tropicau damb nòm e s'originèc ena part orientau deth nomentat ocean.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Era tempèsta, localizada apruprètz a 3000 miles de Miami, Florida, presente vents qu'artenhen ua velocitat maximala constanta de 40 mph (64 quilomètres per ora).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Es expèrts deth Centre Nacionau d'Auragans pronostiquen que Danielle s'intensificarà enquiara categoria d'auragan eth pròplèu dimèrcles.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Com qu'era tempèsta ei luenh d'arribar en tèrra, encara ei dificil analisar eth potenciau impacte qu'aurà enes Estats Units o en Carib.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek, neishut en Zagreb, caplòc de Croàcia, guanhèc popularitat mentre jogaue damb eth Partizan de Belgrad.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Se junhec en 1945 e demorèc aquiu enquia 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: En sòn pas peth club, marquèc 403 gòls en 468 partits.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Cap aute jogador a jogat mès partits o a marcat mès gòls en favor deth club que Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Siguec escuelhut eth milhor fotbolista dera istòria deth Partizan en 1995.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Es celebracions s'inicièren damb un espectacle especiau en mans deth grop Cirque du Soleil, globaument coneishut.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Ara seguida, actuèren era Orquèstra Sinfonica Estatau d'Istambol, un grop de geníssers e es cantaires Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Mès tard, Whirling Derviches hec era sua aparicion en scenari.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Era diva turca Sezen Aksu cantèc damb Alessandro Safina, un tenor italian, e damb eth cantaire grèc Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Tà finalizar er espectacle, eth grop de dança turca Anatolia interpretèc «Troy».
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un corredor de corses de motocicletes de 13 ans, moric dempús de participar en un accident en Circuït d'Indianapòlis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Pendent eth sòn torn d'escauhament, Lenz queiguec dera sua motocicleta e tot seguit siguec atropelhat peth sòn companh, Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Arrecebec atencion medicau immediata ena pista e siguec trasladat entà un espitau locau, a on moric mès tard.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat gessec indemne der accident.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Zapatero contunhèc dident, en çò que tanh ara situacion financèra a nivèu mondiau, qu' «eth sistèma financèr ei ua part dera economia qu'a ua importància cruciau.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Viuem ua crisi economica des de hè un an, e es dus darrèri mesi an estat es pejors. Considèri que, actuaument, es mercats financèrs an iniciat era sua recuperacion».
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Ena darrèra setmana, Naked News hec a saber publicament qu'incrementarie de forma considerabla eth sòn compromís damb es notícies en lengües internacionaus, damb tres naui programes.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Aguesta organizacion globau, que dejà informe en anglés e en japonés, està lançant programes en espanhòu, italian e corean entara television, Internet e dispositius mobils.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Per sòrt, non me passèc arren, mès presenciè ua scèna macabra quan era gent sajaue de trincar es hièstres entà escapar.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Maugrat qu'es persones emplegauen cagires entà tustar es veires, es hièstres èren impossibles de trincar.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Un suberviuent, Franciszek Kowal, condèc que fin finau un des veires se trinquèc e comencèren a escapar pera hièstra.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Era lum e era calor qu'emane des estèles se genère quan se junhen (o fusionen) es atòms d'idrogèn entà dar lòc a elements mès pesadi.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Es scientifics trabalhen en desvolopar un reactor capable de generar energia dera madeisha manèra.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Açò, totun, ei un problèma de molt dificila solucion e non serà factible arténher eth bastiment de reactors de fusion funcionaus enquia passadi fòrça ans.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Era tension dera superfícia provòque qu'era agulha d'acèr flòte sus era aigua.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Era tension superficiau se produsís pr'amor qu'es molecules d'aigua ena superfícia s'atrèn damb fòrça mès intensitat qu'es molecules d'aire que se trapen peth dessús d'eres.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Es molecules d'aigua formen ua pellicula invisibla sus era sua superfícia que permet qu'objèctes coma es agulhes flòten sus era aigua.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Era lama des patins de gèu modèrns compde damb ua dobla vòra damb un horat concau en miei, çò que permet ua milhor aderéncia ath gèu, enquia quan s'inclinen.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Coma qu'era part inferiora dera lama ei leugèrament acorbaishada, en inclinar-la cap a un costat o cap ar aute, era vòra que demore en contacte damb eth gèu tanben s'acorbaishe.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Açò hè qu'eth patinador vire. Quan es patins s'inclinen tara dreta, eth patinador tanben vire en aguesta direccion; s'ac hèn tara quèrra, virarà tara quèrra.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Entà recuperar eth nivèu d'energia anterior, s'an de liberar d'energia èxtra qu'an obtengut dera lum.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Açò ac amien a tèrme en tot eméter ua petita particula de lum cridada «foton».
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Es expèrts nomenten ad aguest procès «emission estimulada de radiacion», pr'amor qu'era lum blanca estimule as atòms, çò que genère era emission d'un foton de lum, qu'ei un tipe de radiacion.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ena següenta imatge s'illustren atòms qu'emeten fotons. Per descompdat, es fotons son, en vertat, fòrça mès petiti qu'es que mòstre era imatge.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Era mida des fotons ei enquia mès petit qu'eth dera matèria que compause es atòms!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dempús de foncionar per centenats d'ores, er hilament dera ampola acabe per cremar-se e aguesta dèishe de foncionar.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Alavetz, cau cambiar era ampola. Ei de besonh anar damb compde en cambiar era ampola.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Çò de prumèr que cau hèr damb era lum ei amortar eth sòn interruptor o desconnectar-la.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Eth motiu ei qu'era electricitat que cor entara dolha, a on se trape era part metallica dera ampola, pòt causar ua descarga electrica grèu se se tòque er interior d'aguest interruptor o era basa metallica dera ampola mentre encara ei parciaument laguens dera dolha.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Eth còr, que pompe era sang, ei er organ mès important deth sistèma circulatòri.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Era sang fluís des deth còr a trauès d'ues vies cridades artèries e i retorne per d'autes aperades venes. Es conductes mès petiti de toti arreceben eth nòm de capillars.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Damb era sua dentadura, un triceratòps auesse pogut triturar non sonque huelhes, senon tanben branques e arraïtzes fòrça dures.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Segontes cren quauqui scientifics, era alimentacion deth triceratòps ère a basa de ciques, un tipe de planta comuna en periòde deth Cretaci.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Aguestes plantes se semblen a ua petita palmera damb ua corona de huelhes ahilades e espinoses.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Eth triceratòps poderie auer arringat es huelhes damb eth sòn robust bèc abans de minjar-se eth tronc.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: D'auti scientifics sostien que son pòques es probabilitats que quauque dinosaure s'alimentèsse damb aguestes plantes, pr'amor que son extremament podonhoses; totun, actuaument, eth peresós e d'autes espècies, coma eth parroquet (que descen des dinosaures), pòden ingerir huelhes o fruts podonhosi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Quin efècte aurie en jo era gravetat d'Io? Se vos se trobèssetz ena superfícia deth satellit, pesaríetz mens qu'ena Tèrra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Quauquarrés que pese 200 liures (90 kg) ena Tèrra, pesarie ues 36 liures (16 kg) en Io. Açò signifique, evidentament, qu'era sua gravetat exercís mens atraccion.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Eth Solei non a ua escòrça coma era Tèrra, sus era quau podetz estar. Eth Solei ei compausat ena sua totalitat per gasi, huec e plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: A mesura que pèrd proximitat damb eth Solei, eth gas se torne mès leugèr.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Era part extèrna que pòt observar-se en dirigir era vista ath Solei se cride fotosfèra; que signifique, «esfèra de lum».
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Uns tres mil ans dempús, en 1610, er astronòm italian, Galilèu Galilei, podec observar, a trauès deth telescòpi, que Venus auie fases, atau coma les a era lua.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Es fases s'expliquen pr'amor que sonque s'illumine era cara de Venus (o dera Lua) que guarde cap ath Solei. Aguest fenomèn balhèc supòrt ara teoria copernicana, que ditz qu'es planetes se botjen en tot entornejar ath Solei.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Posteriorament, en 1639, Jeremiah Horrocks, un astronòm d'Anglatèrra, observèc un transit de Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Dempús de reconquistar Danelaw, Anglatèrra gaudic d'un esperlongat periòde pacific.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Totun, en 991, Ethelred lutèc contra era flòta vikinga mès grana vista des dera de Guthrum, deth sègle anterior.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson, un norvegian damb ambicion tà recuperar era sua nacion deth domeni danés, ère eth cap dera flòta.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dempús d'afrontar contratempsi militars iniciaus, Etelred artenhec arribar a un acòrd damb Olaf, qui tornèc tà Norvègia entà sajar de guanhar eth sòn reiaume damb un succès relatiu.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Er alfabet hangul ei er unic dessenhat de manèra arbitrària qu'encara s'utilize ena vida vidanta. S'inventèc en 1444, pendent eth reine de Sejong (1418 a 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong siguec eth quatau monarca dera dinastia Joseon e ei un des mès respectadi.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Eth nòm originau que se li dèc ar alfabet Hangeul siguec Hunmin Jeongeum, que signifique «es sons avienti entà instruïr ath pòble».
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Existissen nombroses teories sus com arribèc a existir eth sanscrit. Ua d'eres parle d'ua migracion ariana des d'occident enquiara Índia, que i portèc era lengua.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Era lengua sanscrita ei antiga, comparabla ath latin parlat en Euròpa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Eth prumèr libre deth mon siguec escrit en sanscrit. Dempús deth recuelh des Upanishads, aguesta lengua simplament desapareishec, per ahèrs de jerarquia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Eth sanscrit ei un idiòma complèx e ric que servic coma hònt tà fòrça lengües modèrnes dera Índia, atau coma eth latin ei hònt des lengües europèes, coma eth francés e er espanhòu.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: En finalizar era batalha de França, Alemanha comencèc a planificar era invasion dera ièrla de Gran Bretanha.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanha assignèc ar atac eth nòm en clau de «Operacion Leon Marin». Era armada britanica ère plan febla, pr'amor qu'auie perdut era majoria des armes pesades e es subministraments pendent era sua evacuacion de Dunkerque.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Totun, era Marina Reau encara ère fòrça mès fòrta qu'era alemanha (Kriegsmarine) e poderie auer abatut a quinsevolha flòta invasora qu'auesse sajat de trauessar eth Canau dera Manja.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Totun, èren fòrça pòques es bases des vaishèts dera Marina Reau que se plaçauen apròp des possibles rotes d'invasion, donques qu'es amirals temien qu'un atac aerian alemanh les enfonsèsse.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Comencem en tot explicar es plans d'Itàlia. Fondamentaument, Itàlia ère eth «frair petit» d'Alemanha e Japon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Era sua armada e marina èren mès febles, encara qu'auien bastit quate vaishèths naui just abans der inici dera guèrra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Itàlia auie coma objectius primordiaus es païsi africans. Entà capturar-les, li calerie ua plataforma de lançament de tropes entà qu'aguestes podessen navegar pera Mar Mediterranèa e, atau, aucupar Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Entad açò, s'auien de liberar des bases e des vaishèths britanics localizadi en Egipte. Apart d'aguestes accions, es batalhes navaus d'Itàlia non auien cap aute objectiu.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: En çò que tanh a Japon, aguest ei un país insular, coma Gran Bretanha.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Es sosmarins son naus dessenhades entà desplaçar-se e demorar per baish dera aigua pendent un long periòde de temps.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Pendent era Prumèra e era Dusau Guèrra Mondiau s'utilizèren sosmarins. Alavetz, èren fòrça lents e auien ua artenhuda de tir fòrça limitada.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ath començament dera guèrra, viatjauen principaument sus eth nivèu dera mar, mès, a mesura que se desvolopèren es radars e aqueriren major precision, es sosmarins se vederen forçadi a immergir-se entà evitar èster detectadi.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Es sosmarins alemanhs s'aperèren O-Boote. Es alemanhs èren fòrça boni en hèr a navegar e operar es sòns sosmarins.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Dempús deth sòn succès damb es sosmarins, passada era guèrra, non se confie en qu'es alemanhs agen guairi sosmarins.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Òc! Un des reis mès coneishudi der ancian Egipte en mon modèrn ei eth rei Tutankamon, a viatges cridat «Rei Tut» o «eth Rei Mainatge».
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Curiosament, ena antiquitat non siguec considerat guaire important, e non siguec enregistrat ena majoria des listres reiaus ancianes.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Totun, se tornèc famós dempús deth descorbiment deth sòn cavòt en 1922. Mentre que fòrça sepulcres ancians sigueren saquejats, eth de Tutankamon demorèc lèu intacte.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Era major part des objèctes que sigueren enterradi damb Tutankamon s'an conservat en bon estat, entre eri, milenats d'artefactes elaboradi damb metaus preciosi e pèires exotiques.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Era invencion des arròdes radiades convertic as cariòts asiris en veïculs mès leugèrs, rapids e milhor premanidi entà escapar des soldats e d'auti cariòts.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Es letaus flèches des balèstes podien penetrar ena armadura des soldats enemics. Cap ar an 1000 a. C., es asiris introdusiren era prumèra cavalheria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Era cavalheria ei ua fòrça de combat que lute a shivau. En aqueth temps, encara non existien es montures; era cavalheria asiria batalhèc sus es esquies nudes des equins.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Coneishem a nombrosi politics, scientifics e artistes grècs. Ei probable qu'era figura mès famosa d'aguesta cultura sigue Homèr, eth legendari poèta cèc, escrivan de dus poèmes, òbres mèstres dera literatura grèga: era Iliada e era Odissèa.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofòcles e Aristofanes son encara escrivans d'òbres de teatre famosi e es sòns trabalhs se considèren des melhors dera literatura mondiau.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Ua auta figura grèga de renòm ei Pitagòres, matematic majoritariament coneishut a causa deth sòn famós teorèma sus era relacion entre es costats des triangles rectangles.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: S'an hèt diuèrses estimacions sus eth nombre de parlants der indi. Se calcule qu'ei entre eth dusau e quatau idiòma que mès quantitat de persones parlen ena planeta.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Era quantitat de parlants natius depen de se se compden o non es dialèctes similars.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Calculs estimen qu'existissen entre 340 e 500 milions de persones que parlen er idiòma e enquia 800 milions que lo pòden compréner.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Er indi e er urdú son similars en çò que tanh ath vocabulari, mès son disparièrs ena escritura. Enes convèrses de cada dia, es parlants des dus idiòmes pòden, tot soent, comprener-se es uns damb es auti.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Era cultura alemanha exercie ua mercada influéncia en nòrd d'Estònia ath torn deth sègle XV.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Quauqui monges d'Alemanha volien apropar era gent nativa a Diu, motiu peth quau inventèren era lengua escrita estoniana.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Era sua basa siguec er alfabet alemanh e s'incorporèc eth caractèr: «Õ/ õ».
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Damb eth transcors deth temps, fòrça mots prenudi der alemanh se fusionèren. Açò merquèc er inici dera illustracion.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ei tradicion qu'eth futur successor deth tròn s'aliste dirèctament ena armada dempús de finalizar era sua educacion escolara.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Totun, Charles assistic ara universitat Trinity College, Cambridge. Aquiu estudièc antropologia e arqueologia e, temps dempús, istòria, en tot obtier un 2:2 (un grad inferior de dusau classa).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles siguec eth prumèr membre dera familha reau britanica en obtier un títol universitari.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Era Turquia europèa (èst de Tràcia Orientau o Rumèlia, ena peninsula des Balcans) compren eth 3% deth país.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Eth territòri de Turquia a mès de 1600 quilomètres de long (1000 miles), 800 quilomètres d'ample (500 eth miles) e a ua forma mès o mens rectangular.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Era superfícia de Turquia, includidi es lacs, aucupe 783.562 quilomètres quarradi, des quaus, 755.688 se tròben ena Àsia sud-occidentau e 23.764 en Euròpa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Era superfícia de Turquia hè que sigue eth 37au país deth mon mès gran, damb mida similara ara dera França metropolitana e eth Reiaume Unit amassa.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Tres des costats de Turquia son entornejadi per mars: ar oèst, eth Mar Egèu; ath nòrd, eth Mar Nere e ath sud, eth Mediterranèu.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemborg a molta istòria, mès era sua independéncia non arribèc enquiar an 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: En passat, es parts actuaus de Belgica apartiegen a Luxemborg, mès, dempús dera Revolucion bèlga de 1830, se tornèren bèlgues.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemborg tostemp a sajat de mantier-se coma un estat nèutre; totun, Alemanha lo aucupèc en andues guèrres mondiaus.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Luxemborg passèc a èster, en 1957, membre fondador de çò qu'aué cridam Union Europèa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ei ua fortalesa e un monastèri bodista en pardies que se tròbe ath nòrd deth barri Paro, en Phondey Village.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Segontes conde era istòria, en 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel bastic era fortificacion damb era intencion de commemorar eth sòn trionf contra era armada tibetan-mongòl.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Eth retrat de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal ei ua des pòques relíquies qu'an demorat deth Drukgyal Dzong, coma conseqüéncia d'un incendi en an 1951.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dempús der incendi, era fortalesa se preservèc e protegic, e contunhe en tot èster ua  des atraccions mès formidables de Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Cambòtja demorèc acorralada entre dus poderosi vesins pendent eth sègle XVIII. Eri èren Tailàndia e Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Pendent eth sègle XVIII Cambòtja patic diuèrses invasions des tailandesi, qui, en 1772, destruïren Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Pendent es darrèri ans deth sègle XVIII, Cambòtja tanben patic invasions vietnamites.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Eth dètz-e-ueit per cent des veneçolans se trapen en caumatge, e era majoria des qu'an trabalh, trabalhen ena economia submergida.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dus tèrci des trabalhadors veneçolans exercissen en sector des servicis, lèu ua quatau part trabalhe ena indústria e ua cincau part, ena agricultura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: En Veneçuèla eth petròli ei ua indústria importanta, eth país ei un exportador net, encara que sonque er 1% dera sua poblacion trabalhe en aguest sector.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Enes inicis dera independéncia dera nacion, es expèrts deth Jardin Botanic de Singapor ajudèren a transformar era ièrla en ua Ciutat Jardin Tropicau.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: En 1981, s'escuelhec ara orquidèa de Singapor, qu'ei un cultiu ibrid, coma era flor nacionau.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Toti es ans, tà octobre, apruprètz 1,5 milions d'erbivòrs emigren cap as planhères deth sud, en tot trauessar er arriu Mara, des des tucolets deth nòrd, en cèrca des ploges.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E dempús, tornen tath nòrd per oèst, nauament en tot trauessar er arriu Mara, en tot cercar es ploges qu'arriben pendent abriu.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ena region de Serengeti se tròbe eth Parc Nacionau deth Serengeti, era zòna de conservacion de Ngorongoro e era Resèrva de Caça Maswa, totes eres en Tanzania. En Kenya se localize era Resèrva Nacionau Massai Mara.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Apréner a desvolopar mejans interactius implique compdar damb abiletats convencionaus e tradicionaus, ath delà deth domeni d'esturments en classes interactives (guidon grafic, edicion d'àudio e vidèo, narrativa, etc.).
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Eth dessenh interactiu requerís que tornetz a avalorar es vòstes assumpcions sus produccion audiovisuau e que desvolopetz un pensament non linhau.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Eth dessenh interactiu requerís qu'es compausants d'un projècte se connècten entre eri, mès qu'ath madeish temps consèrven eth sòn sens coma entitats separades.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Er aspècte negatiu des objectius damb zoom ei qu'era complexitat focau e era quantitat d'elements der objectiu que se requerissen entà arténher un reng de longituds focaus ei fòrça major qu'es de besonh entàs objectius fixes.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Aguest problèma cada viatge ei mens important gràcies a qu'es fabricants de lents artenhen estandards mès nauti ena sua produccion.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Açò a hèt possible qu'es objectius damb zoom produsisquen fotografies d'ua qualitat similara ara obtenguda pes objectius damb distància focau fixa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un aute desauantatge des lents damb zoom ei qu'era maximala dubertura (era velocitat) dera lent ei, tot soent, mès redusida.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Açò hè qu'es lents damb zoom economics non siguen facils d'utilizar en condicions de pòca lum o sense flaish.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un des problèmes mès comuns quan se tracte de convertir ua pellicula a DVD ei er overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Eth dessenh dera majoria des televisions a coma objectiu complàser ath public generau.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ei per aguest motiu que totes es imatges que ves ena television apareishen damb es vòres superiores, inferiores e lateraus talhades.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Açò se hè entà garantir qu'era imatge se desplegue ena pantalha complèta. Açò s'apère “overscan”.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Malurosament, en crear un DVD, ei fòrça probable qu'es vòres demoren talhades e, s'eth vidèo a subtítols massa apròp deth marge inferior, non se veiràn sancers.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Eth castèth tipic medievau a servit d'inspiracion pendent molt de temps ara imaginacion, en tot evocar imatges de justes, taulejades e galhardia arturiana.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Enquia depès estant entre roïnes millenàries, ei simple evocar es sons e es flaires des batalhes de ua auta epòca; que lèu escotatz er impacte des casqui damb es teules e sentetz era pòur qu'emergie des des gàbies.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Mès, ei era nòsta imaginacion basada ena realitat? Perqué quauquarrés bastic castèths iniciaument? Quin metòde s'empleguèc entà dessenhar-les e bastir-les?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipic dera epòca, eth castèth Kirby Muxloe ei mèslèu ua casa fortificada qu'un castèth de vertat.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Es sues granes hièstres de veire e es sòns primi murs non poderien auer resistit un atac pendent guaire temps.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: En decènni de 1480, quan Lord Hastings inicièc era sua edificacion, eth país ère en ua situacion de patz relativa e sonque calie era defensa contra petiti grops de delinqüents errants.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Er equilibri de poder ère un sistèma a trauès deth quau es païsi europèus sajauen de mantier era soberania nacionau de cadun des estats d'aguest continent.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Es govèrns nacionaus soent cambiauen es sues aliances damb era fin de mantier er equilibri, pr'amor que compartien eth concèpte de que totes es nacions europèes auien de sajar d'empedir que sonque ua nacion se hesse poderosa.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Era Guèrra de Succession d'Espanha siguec era prumèra qu'eth sòn objectiu principau siguec er equilibri de poder.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Açò supausèc un cambi de grana importància, dat qu'es poténcies europèes dejà non poderien recórrer ath pretèxte des guèrres religioses. Per açò, era guèrra des Trenta ans serie era darrèra en catalogar-se coma guèrra religiosa.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Eth 21 de junhsèga der an 356 a. C. se destruïc eth temple d'Artemisa en Efes, en un incendi provocat per Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Conden qu'era sua motivacion ère arténher reputacion a quinsevolh prètz. Es efesi, indignadi per açò, anoncièren que jamès s'enregistrarie eth nòm de Herostratus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Eth grèc Estrabon, erudit en istòria, apuntèc eth sòn nòm mès tard, e atau ei com aué le coneishem. Eth temple se destruïc era madeisha net en qué neishec Alexandre eth Gran.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, coma rei, aufric pagar era reconstruccion deth temple, mès refusèren era sua prepausa. Mès tard, dempús dera sua mòrt, eth temple siguec rebastit en 323 a. C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Asseguratz-vos qu'auetz era man dreta tan relaxada coma sigue possible, sense deishar de tocar es nòtes corrèctament. Ath delà, auetz de sajar de non hèr guairi moviments estranhi damb es dits.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Atau, vos cansaratz çò de mens possible. Ajatz present que, a diferéncia deth piano, non cau pressionar guaire fòrt es tecles entà obtier un major volum.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Se desiratz elevar eth volum en tocar er acordeon, auetz d'utilizar era pompa damb mès pression o velocitat.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Eth misticisme ei era recèrca deth ligam, era identitat o era reconeishença conscienta d'ua realitat suprèma, divinitat, vertat immateriau o Diu.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Eth desir deth credent ei ua experiéncia dirècta, sensacion o percepcion dera realitat divina, deth Diu o divinitats.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Es seguidors se prepausen adoptar cèrtes formes de vida o practiques qu'an coma objectiu neurir aguestes experiéncies.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Eth misticisme pòt diferenciar-se de d'auti tipes de credences e cultes religiosi pera sua enfasi ena experiéncia personau dirècta d'un estat unic de consciéncia, en particular, es de caractèr pacific, sagaç, joiós o enquia euforic.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Eth sikhisme ei un culte religiós provenent deth subcontinent indi. Neishec en sègle XV ena zòna de Punjab, coma resultat d'ua division sectària laguens der indoïsme.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Es sikhs an era conviccion de qu'era sua fe constituís ua religion desligada der indoïsme, mès arreconeishen es sues origines e tradicions indós.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Es sikhs nomenten Gurmat ara sua religion, que, en punjabi, vò díder «camin deth gurú». Eth gurú ei un aspècte essenciau de totes es religions dera Índia, mès, en sikhisme, a crubat ua grana importància e conforme er èish des credences sikhs.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Guru Nank (1469- 1569) fondèc era religion en sègle XV e li seguiren, de forma successiva, d'auti naui gurús.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Totun, en junh de 1956, se meteren a pròva es promeses de Krushchev, quan es albaròts en Polonha dirigidi per trabalhadors que protestauen pera manca d'aliments e es reduccions salariaus, derivèren en ua manifestacion generau contra eth comunisme.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Tot e que finaument Krushev envièc tancs damb er objectiu de restablir er orde, cedic deuant de quauques exigéncies de tipe economic e accedic a nomentar ath popular Wladyslaw Gomulka coma eth nau prumèr ministre.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Era civilizacion dera Val d'Indus se desvolopèc ena Edat de Bronze, en subcontinent deth nòrd-oèst dera Índia, que compren era major part der aué territòri paquistanés e quauques zònes deth nòrd-oèst dera Índia e eth nòrd-èst d'Afganistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Era civilizacion floric ena conca der arriu Indus, deth quau ne derive eth nòm.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Maugrat açò, quauqui expèrts estimen que, a causa de qu'era civilizacion tanben existic enes conques der arriu Sarasvati, aué shut, serie mès acertat aperar-la civilizacion Indus-Sarasvati; pera sua part, d'auti la criden civilizacion Harappa, qu'ei eth nòm deth prumèr lòc en èster excavat en decènni des ans vint.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Era natura militara der empèri roman contribuïc ath desvolopament des auanci en camp dera medecina.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Er emperaire August comencèc a recrutar mètges que, de hèt, formèren eth prumèr còs medicau roman, qu'auie era foncion d'intervier dempús des batalhes.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Es cirurgians compdauen damb coneishences sus diuèrsi sedants, coma era morfina extrèta des semes d'òpi o era escopolamina, obtenguda de semes dera èrba deth caishau.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Se convertiren en especialistes en amputacion entà sauvar a qui patie gangrena e tanben en hèr torniquets e en emostàsia entà talhar eth flux de sang.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Damb eth pas des sègles, er empèri roman portèc grani auanci en airau dera medecina e desvolopèc grana part des coneishements qu'auem ena actualitat.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Er origami Pureland ei un origami que sonque permet realizar un plec ath madeish viatge, non se pòden hèr plecs complèxes, coma es invertidi, e toti es plecs an ubicacions simples.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Ac desvolopèc John Smith enes ans setanta entà ajudar as practicants inexpèrts o as qui auien limitades es abiletats motores.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Des de fòrça joeni, es mainatges desvolopen cèrta consciéncia sus era raça e es estereotipes raciaus, e aguesti darrèri afècten ath sòn comportament.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Per exemple, es infants que s'identifiquen damb ua minoria raciau que pòrte er estereotipe de non anar ben ena escòla, desvolopen ua tendéncia ath fracàs escolar un còp que prenen coneishença der estereotipe restacat damb era sua raça.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ei eth tresau lòc web mès popular en emplec enes Estats Units e, actuaument, compde damb 54 milions de perfils.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Aguesti lòcs web an arrecebut fòrça atencion, en particular en entorn educatiu.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Existissen aspèctes positius en aguesti lòcs web, coma era possibilitat de configurar de forma simpla ua pagina de classes virtuaus que pòt contier blògs, vidèos e fotografies, e d'autes foncions.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Aguesta pagina ei d'accès simple, pr'amor qu'a ua unica adreça web, çò que hè qu'aqueri estudiants que podessen auer problèmes entà usar eth teclat o damb era ortografia, poguen arrebrembar-la e escriuer-la damb facilitat.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Se pòt personalizar entà que sigue de facila lectura e, tanben, regular era preséncia de color, segontes se preferisque.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Eth trastorn per deficit d'atencion «ei un sindròme neurologic que, classicament, s'a definit coma ua simptomatologia qu'includís impulsivitat, distraccion e iperactivitat o excès d'energia».
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Non se tracte d'ua dificultat d'aprendissatge, senon mèslèu d'un trastorn deth aprendissatge; «ac patissen entre eth 3 e eth 5 per cent des mainatges, possiblament enquia 2 milions d'infants en Estats Units».
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Es mainatges damb TDA an dificultat entà concentrar-se en causes coma es prètzhèts escolars, mès pòden concentrar-se damb activitats que les agraden, coma jogar, guardar es sòns diboishi animats preferidi o escríuer oracions sense signes de puntuacion.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Aguesti mainatges tendissen a meter-se en molti problèmes, pr'amor qu' «adòpten comportaments arriscadi, s'impliquen en peleges e desafien ara autoritat» entà estimular eth sòn cervèth, donques qu'aguest non pòt estimular-se per metòdes normaus.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Eth TDA afècte as ligams damb d'auti companhs, dat qu'es auti mainatges non artenhen a compréner perqué eri actuen coma ac hèn, perqué escriuen dera manèra en qu'escriuen o perqué non compartissen eth madeish nivèu de maturitat.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: A mesura qu'era capacitat d'aquerir coneishements e d'apréner a cambiat, atau com s'a mencionat anteriorament, tanben a cambiat era velocitat damb era quau s'obten eth coneishement.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Era manèra d'obtier informacion ère diferent. Eth fòcus ja non apuntaue ara memòria individuau, senon mèslèu ara capacitat d'arrebrembar un tèxte.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Basicament, eth Renaishement signifiquèc un cambi significatiu ena perspectiva der aprendissatge e era difusion deth coneishement.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Es ominids, en contrast damb d'auti simis, ja non utilizen es sues mans entà botjar-se, ne entà tier pes, ne entà balancejar-se entre es arbes.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Er hèt qu'era man e eth pè deth chimpanzé siguen de mida e longada similares hè evident qu'empleguen era extremitat superiora coma supòrt deth sòn pes en caminar damb es nudets.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Era longada dera man der èster uman ei mès cuerta qu'era deth pè e es sòns dits son mès drets.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Uassi de mans fossilizadi de hè dus a tres milions d'ans hèn evident aguest cambi ena especializacion dera man dera locomocion ara manipulacion.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: I a gent que cre que someter-se a fòrça sessions d'induccion de sònis lucids de forma artificiau pòt èster quauquarren reaument agotador.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Era principau explicacion d'aguest fenomèn ei qu'a conseqüéncia des sònis lucids,  s'alongue eth temps entre estats REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: En produsir-se mens REM pera net, se redusís era frequéncia d'aguest estat damb eth quau se descanse e eth còs recupère era sua energia, e se torne sufisentament escàs coma entà convertir-se en un problèma.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Açò ei tan desgastant coma se vos auéssetz de desvelhar cada vint o trenta menutes a guardar era television.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Er efècte depen dera freqüéncia damb era qu'eth vòste cervèth sage de hèr sònis lucids per net.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Lèu des deth començament, as italians non les anèc guaire ben per Africa deth nòrd. Passada ua setmana des de qu'Itàlia declarèsse era guèrra, eth 10 de junh de 1940, era onzau division d'ussars britanics capturèren ath Fòrt Capuzzo, en Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Eth generau Lastucci, enginhèr cap deth detzau exercit d'Itàlia, siguec capturat pes anglesi en ua emboscada ar èst de Bardia.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Eth huec aliat eliminèc, eth 28 de junh, a Marshal Italo Balbo, governador generau de Libia e successor naturau de Mussolini, mentre aterraue en Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Era escrima, espòrt modèrn, se practique a nivèus fòrça variadi, des des estudiants dera universitat enquiàs olimpics e competidors professionaus.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Era forma principau de practicar aguest espòrt ei a trauès de duèls, a on dus escrimistes s'afronten.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Eth gòlf ei un espòrt en qu'es participaires sagen d'introdusir pilòtes en clòts, en tot tustar-les damb un garròt.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Se disputen dètz-e-ueit clòts pendent ua ronda regular e, per çò de generau, es jogadors comencen peth prumèr clòt deth camp e acaben en dètz-e-ueitau.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Guanhe eth jogador que hè a servir mens tustaments, o swings, entà completar eth  circuït.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Eth partit se jògue sus gespa, e era èrba qu'entornege eth clòt se talhe mès e s'apère green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Dilhèu eth tipe de torisme mès abituau ei aqueth qu'era majoria des persones restaque damb er hèt de viatjar: eth torisme recreatiu.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Açò arribe quan es viatgèrs escuelhen ua destinacion fòrça diferenta ara dera sua vida vidanta damb era fin de relaxar-se e divertir-se.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Es plages, es parcs tematics e es campings son, soent, es lòcs que mès freqüenten  es toristes que viatgen per plaser.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Eth torisme culturau ei aqueth qu'eth sòn objectiu ei eth de visitar un lòc en particular entà conéisher era sua istòria e era sua cultura.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Es toristes pòden visitar diuèrsi punts emblematics d'un país en particular o simplament optar per centrar-se en un solet airau.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: En veir aguesta activitat, es colons tanben demanèren renfortiments.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Es tropes de renfortiment entàs posicions davantères includiren ath 1.èr e ath 3.au regimient de New Hampshire, damb 200 soldats, jos eth comandament des coronèls John Stark e James Reed, es quaus dempús ascendiren a generaus.
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Es òmes de Stark se despleguèren ath long dera barrèra en extrem nòrd dera ubicacion des colons.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quan era marèa baisha dauric ua henedura ath costat der arriu Mystic, ath long deth nòrd-èst dera peninsula, rapidament esperlonguèren era barrèra cap ath nòrd damb un mur baish de pèira qu'arribaue apròp dera aigua d'ua petita plaja.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark plantèren ua estaca a uns 100 pès (30 mètres) peth deuant dera barrèra e dèren era orde qu'arrés daurisse huec enquia qu'er exercit britanic la passèsse.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Era estrategia d'EE. UU. siguec eth lançament d'atacs coordinadi des de tres punts desparièrs.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Eth generau John Cadwalder iniciarie un atac de distraccion contra era tropa britanica en Bordentown, damb era fin de bloquejar quinsevolh refortiment.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Eth generau James Ewing evitarie era fuga des tropes enemigues en tot préner eth pònt sus er Assunpink Creek e en tot guidar a 700 soldats a trauès der arriu en Trenton Ferry.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Er atac mès important, damb 2.400 òmes, trauessarie er arriu nau miles ath nòrd de Trenton entà dempús dividir-se en dus grops, un d'eri jos eth comandament de Greene e, er aute, dirigit per Sullivan, damb era fin de lançar un atac abans de que gessesse eth solei.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Damb eth cambi dera corsa d'un quart a mieja mila, era velocitat deven molt mès important, e era resisténcia se torne un besonh absolut.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Un corredor de mieja mila de prumèra categoria, qu'ei un òme que la pòt superar en dues menutes, evidentament a d'auer un bon nivèu de velocitat, mès tanben a de cultivar era resisténcia per toti es mieis.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Era milhor forma de premanir-se entara sason de corses ei combinar corses camp a trauès, pendent era epòca iuernau, damb un entrenament dera part superiora deth còs en gimnàs.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Non ei possible qu'es practiques nutricionaus avientes, per si soletes, genèren un rendiment d'elit, mès pòden influïr significativament en benèster generau des atlètes joeni.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Auer un equilibri energetic saludable, adoptar abituds d'idratacion eficaces e préner coneishença des desparièrs aspèctes des practiques de suplementacin pòt contribuïr a qu'es atlètes incrementen eth sòn rendiment e gaudisquen mès der espòrt.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Era corsa de distància mieja ei un espòrt relativament economic; totun, i a molta confusion en çò que tanh as pòqui equipaments que calen entà participar-i.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Es productes se pòden aquerir quan sigue de besonh; totun, era majoria non aurà impacte vertadèr en rendiment, o era sua incidéncia serà minima.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Es atlètes pòden auer era sensacion de preferir un producte, encara qu'aguest non proporcione beneficis reaus.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Er atòm pòt èster considerat coma un des pilars entath bastiment de tota era matèria.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ei ua estructura fòrça complèxa qu'ei formada, segontes eth modèu simplificat de Bohr, per un nuclèu centrau orbitat per electrons; similar de bèra manèra as planetes que viren ath torn deth Solei. Guardatz era Figura 1.1.
