text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Eth nuclèu ei compausat per dues particules; protons e neutrons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Es neutrons non an carga electrica, es protons an carga positiva e, es electrons, an carga negatiua.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Entà examinar ara victima, prumèr auetz d'inspeccionar era scèna ara fin de garantir era pròpria seguretat.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Auetz d'observar era posicion dera victima en apropar-vos ada era, atau coma quinsevolh senhau d'alèrta automatica.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Se te hès mau quan sages d'ajudar, sonque empejoraràs era situacion.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Er estudi determinèc qu'era depression, era pòur e era catastrofizacion intervengueren ena dinamica deth dolor e era discapacitat enes pacients damb mau d'esquia.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Sonque es efèctes deth catastrofisme, e non dera depression ne dera pòur, èren condicionadi as sessions regulares setmanaus d'activitat fisica.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Es qui practicauen ua activitat regulara requeriren major supòrt en tèrmes de percepcion negatiua deth dolor, en tot mercar es distincions entre eth dolor cronic e era sensacion de malèster present en moviment fisic abituau.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Era vista, o era capacitat de veir, depen des organs sensoriaus (uelhs) deth sistèma visuau.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Existissen nombroses estructures oculares diuèrses; era sua complexitat vàrie en foncion des besonhs der organisme.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Es diuèrsi bastiments an desparières possibilitats, son sensibles a diferentes longituds d'onda e an diferents grads de finesa; tanben requerissen un tractament diferenciat entà dar sens ar estimul entrant e nombres diferents entà que foncionen de forma excellenta.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Ua poblacion ei un conjunt d'organismes d'ua madeisha espècia concrèta en ua zòna geografica especifica.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: As individús membres d'ua poblacion que compartissen quauqua caracteristica fenotipica particulara se les apère monomorfics.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Es individús que mòstren diuèrses variantes d'ua madeisha caracteristica particulara son polimorfics.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Es colònies de hormigues guerrères tanben caminen e hèn nins en desparières fases.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Pendent era fasa nomada, es hormigues guerrères auancen pera net e, de dia, s'arturen entà acampar.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Era colònia comence ua fasa nomada quan eth minjar disponible a amendrit. En aguesta fasa, formen nins temporaus que se càmbien cada dia.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Cadua d'aguestes desfilades o marches dure apruprètz 17 dies.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Qué ei ua cellula? Aguest tèrme derive deth latin “cella”, que signifique «cramba petita», e siguec emplegat per prumèr viatge per un microscopista mentre estudiaue era estructura deth suro.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Era unitat basica de tot èster viu ei era cellula e cada organisme ei format per ua o mès cellules.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Es cellules son basiques e cruciaus entar estudi dera vida. En efècte, damb freqüéncia, se les nomente «es compausants basics dera vida».
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Eth sistèma nerviós manten era omeostasi a trauès d'impulsi nerviosi qu'envie a tot eth còs entà qu'eth flux sanguini corgue sense interrupcions.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Aguesti impulsi nerviosi pòden èster enviadi tan rapidament a trauès der organisme, qu'ajuden a mentier-lo segur de quinsevolh menaça potenciau.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Es tornados pataquegen petiti airaus, comparat damb d'autes tempèstes agressives, mès ac pòden destruïr tot en sòn camin.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Es tornados arringuen arbes, trinquen panèus des bastisses e lancen veïculs ath cèu. Eth 2 % des tornados mès agressius duren mès de tres ores.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Aguestes colossaus tempèstes pòrten vents d'enquia 480 quilomètres per ora (133m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Pendent milenats d'ans es persones an fabricat e emplegat lents d'aument.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Maugrat açò, es prumèri vertadèrs telescòpis se desvolopèren en Euròpa, a finaus deth sègle XVI.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Aguesti telescòpis emplegauen ua combinacion de dues lents entà qu'es objèctes aluenhadi semblèssen èster mès apròp e auer major mida.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Era avarícia e er egoïsme tostemp seràn damb nosati e era esséncia dera cooperacion demore en hèt de que quan era majoria se beneficie de quauquarren, tostemp i aurà mès tà guanhar a cuert tèrme se s'actue de manèra egoïsta.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Damb sòrt, era majoria des persones prenen consciéncia de qu'era milhor opcion a long tèrme ei era de trabalhar en collaboracion damb es auti.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Fòrça persones sónien damb eth dia en qu'es umans poderàn viatjar a d'auta estela e explorar d'auti mons. Quauqu'uns se pregunten qué i a aquiu dehòra, d'auti cren qu'en d'auti planetes i pòden víuer extraterrèstres o d'autes formes de vida.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Mès, s'açò arribèsse a arribar, probablament non durarie guaire temps. Es esteles son tan escampilhades qu'existissen bilions de quilomètres de separacion entre esteles «vesies».
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Seràn, dilhèu, es vòsti abans-arrehilhs quauque dia en un mon alienigèn en tot hèr-se qüestions sus es sòns davancièrs?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Es animaus son formadi per nombroses cellules. Mingen causes e les digerissen en sòn interior. Era majoria d'animaus pòt botjar-se.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Es animaus son es unics que possedissen cervèth, mès non toti; es meduses, per exemple, non n'an.
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Es animaus pòden èster trobadi en quinsevolh cornèr dera planeta: caven en solèr, naden enes oceans e vòlen peth cèu.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Era cellula se definís coma era mès petita unitat estructurau e foncionau que forme un organisme (causa) viuent.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Eth tèrme cellula derive deth mot latin cella, que vò díder «cramba petita».
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: S'examines èsters viui jos un microscòpi, avertiràs que son compausadi per petiti quarradi o esfères.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: En tot analisar un suro damb un microscòpi, Robert Hooke, un biològ anglés, observèc petiti quarradi ena sua estructura.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Semblauen abitacions. Siguec era prumèra persona en observar cellules mòrtes.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Es elements e compausats son capables de cambiar d'estat sense patir alteracions.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: En sòn estat gasós, eth nitrogèn manten es madeishes proprietats qu'en sòn estat liquid. En dusau cas ei mès dens, mès es molecules seguissen en tot èster es madeishes.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Un aute exemple ei era aigua, qu'ei formada per dus atòms d'idrogèn e un d'oxigèn.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Presente era madeisha estructura moleculara, sigue en estat liquid, solid o gasós.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Encara qu'eth sòn estat fisic pòt variar, era composicion quimica se manten.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Eth temps ei quauquarren present pertot e qu'a efèctes en totes es nòstes accions; maugrat açò, ei complicat comprené'c.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Academics religiosi, filosofics e scientifics an estudiat eth temps pendent milenats d'ans.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Experimentam eth temps coma ua seria d'eveniments que passen des deth futur peth present enquiath passat.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Eth temps ei tanben ena comparacion que hèm dera durada (extension) des eveniments.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Podetz mercar eth pas deth temps en tot observar com se repetís un eveniment ciclic; açò ei, quauquarren que se produsís un viatge e un aute de forma regulara.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Actuaument, es persones hèn a servir es ordinadors entà manipular imatges e vidèos.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Ei possible dessenhar animacions sofisticades damb ordinador, e aguesta classa d'animacion se hè a servir de manèra creishent autant en television coma en cinèma.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Damb freqüéncia, era gravacion de musica se hè damb ordinadors sofisticadi a fin de tractar e barrejar sons.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Pendent fòrça temps enes sègles XIX e XX,  se creiguie qu'es abitants originaris de Naua Zelanda auien estat es maorís, que caçauen audèths gigants aperadi moes.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Mès tard, era teoria establic era idèa de qu'eth pòble maorí auie emigrat des de Polinesia, a bòrd d'ua Grana Flòta, e que preneren Naua Zelanda as Moriori, en tot installar aquiu ua societat agricòla.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Naues pròves suggerissen, totun, qu'es Moriori sigueren un grop de maorís continentaus que gesseren de Naua Zelanda e se dirigiren as Ièrles Chatham, a on desvolopèren ua cultura diferenciada e pacifica.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Existie, ath delà, ua auta tribú enes ièrles Chatham , formada pes maorís que deishèren Naua Zelanda.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Se nomentèren a eri madeishi es moriori, dempús i aueren quauques peleges e, fin finau, es moriori sigueren anequelidi.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Aqueri que s'i ivolucrèren pendent diuèrsi decènnis, mos ajudèren a avalorar es nòstes fortaleses e passions, ath temps qu'avaloràuem damb sinceritat es dificultats e enquiàs fracassi.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Mentre escotàuem a persones condar es sues istòries personaus, des sues familhes e des sues formes d'organizacion, amassèrem informacion d'utilitat sus eth passat e sus quauques des personalitats qu'aueren efèctes, siguen positius o negatius, ena cultura dera organizacion.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Encara que conéisher es istòries personaus non implique compréner era cultura, aumens ajude as persones a poder representar eth lòc qu'aucupen laguens dera istòria dera organizacion.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Mentre confirmen es exits e prenen consciéncia des fracassi, es individús e grops de persones implicades descorbissen damb major prigondor es valors, er objectiu e es fòrces dera organizacion.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: En aguest cas, arrebrembar experiéncies passades d'un comportament emprenedor, e es exits resultants, ajudèc a arténher qu'es persones se daurissen a naui cambis e direccions entara glèisa locau.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Aguestes istòries de succès amendriren es pòurs ath cambi, en tot crear ua vision positiva deth cambi ath futur.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Es patrons de pensament convergent son metòdes entà resòlver problèmes que restaquen diuèrses idèes o camps, en cèrca d'ua solucion.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Er aspècte centrau d'aguesta forma de pensar ei era velocitat, era logica e era precision, atau coma era identificacion de hèts a trauès dera reutilizacion de tecniques existentes e dera recuelhuda de donades.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Aguesta mentalitat a coma factor principau era existéncia de sonque ua responsa corrècta. Vosati sonque pensatz en dues responses possibles, ua corrècta e ua auta incorrècta.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Aguest tipe de pensament se restaque damb cèrti procediments scientifics o estandards.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Es qui pensen d'aguesta manèra, an un pensament logic, pòden arrebrembar patrons, resòlver problèmes e trabalhar en pròves scientifiques.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Es èsters umans son, per fòrça, era espècia damb mès talent entà liéger era ment des auti.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Açò implique qu'auem era capacitat de hèr prediccions acertades respècte des percepcions de d'autes persones, çò que se prepausen, es sues credences, coneishences e desirs.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Entre aguestes capacitats, compréner era intencion des auti ei cruciau, pr'amor que mos permet resòlver possibles ambigüitats enes accions fisiques.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Per exemple, se ves a quauquarrés trincar era hiestreta d'un coche, probablament assumiràs que sage de panar eth veïcul d'un tresau.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Aurie d'èster jutjat de forma desparièra s'auesse perdut es claus deth coche e eth veïcul que sajaue de forçar auesse estat sòn.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Es imatges per ressonància magnetica (IRM) se basen en un fenomèn fisic aperat ressonància magnetica nucleara (RMN), qu'eth sòn descorbiment auec lòc en decènni de 1930, dera man de Felix Bloch (que trabalhaue entara Universitat de Stanford) e Edward Purcell (dera Universitat de Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Pendent aguesta ressonància, eth camp magnetic e es ondes de ràdio provòquen era emission, per part des atòms, de minuscules senhaus de ràdio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Siguec un mètge e investigador scientific cridat Raymond Damadian qui, en an 1970, descorbic es bases entara utilizacion dera ressonància magnetica per imatges coma estrument entà elaborar diagnostics medicaus.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Dempús de quate ans se li autregèc ua patenta, era prumèra que s'emetie a nivèu mondiau restacada damb era ressonància magnetica.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: En 1977, eth Dr. Damadian acabèc de bastir eth prumèr escanèr de ressonància magnetica de «còs sancer», ath quau nomentèc er «Indomdable».
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Era comunicacion asincronica fomente eth temps entara reflexion e reaccion envèrs as auti.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Açò permet qu'es alumnes trabalhen ath sòn pròpri ritme e contròtlen eth dera informacion instructiva.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Existissen, ath delà, mens limitacions en çò que tanh ath temps, en tot hèr possible oraris laboraus flexibles. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Er emplec d'Internet e der hilat informatic mondiau permet qu'es estudiants agen accès ara informacion en tot moment.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Es alumnes tanben pòden enviar consultes as instructors a quinsevolh ora deth dia e arrecéber ua responsa rasonablament rapida, en lòc de demorar enquiara següenta amassada en persona.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Era aproximacion pòstmodernista der aprendissatge compòrte era libertat des absoluts; non existís sonque ua forma corrècta d'apréner.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: De hèt, non i a arren que sigue bon tà apréner. Er aprendissatge se produsís a trauès dera interaccion entre eth coneishement presentat e er estudiant.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Entà illustrar aguest punt, sonque cau remeter-mos ara nòsta experiéncia actuau damb toti es programes televisius que se basen en er “he-t'ac tu madeish” e ena informacion que presente.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Fòrça de nosati mos auem trobat en tot guardar programes de television que proporcionen informacion sus procèssi o experiéncies que jamès auram ne n'aplicaram es coneishements.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Jamès apraiaram un veïcul, ne bastiram ua hònt en pati deth darrèr de casa nòsta, ne anaram tà Perú entà examinar roïnes ancianes, ne remodelaram era casa deth vesin.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Es connexions de cable de fibra optica sosmarins qu'arriben enquia Euròpa e eth satellit de banda ampla hèn possible que Groenlàndia compde damb bona connectivitat e qu'eth 93% dera sua poblacion age accès a Internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Eth vòste hotèl o anfitrion (se vos lotjatz en ua pension o en ua casa privada) probablament aurà wifi o un ordinador connectat a Internet, e toti es pòbles auràn un cibercafè damb Internet o quauque lòc damb wifi public.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Coma dejà s'a soslinhat, tot e qu'eth mot «esquimau» se contunhe acceptant en EE. UU., fòrça comunitats artiques que non pertanhen as EUA la considèren ofensiva, principaument en Canadà.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Maugrat qu'existís era possibilitat d'escotar era paraula dera boca des natius de Groenlàndia, es estrangèrs aurien d'evitar usar-la.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: En Canadà, es residents natius de Groenlàndia se criden ada eri madeishi inuits e, en Groenlàndia, kalaalleq (plurau kalaallit); ei a díder, groenlandés.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Eth crim e era animadversion envèrs es estrangèrs en generau lèu no existissen en Groenlàndia. Ne tansevolh enes ciutats existissen «zònes perilhoses».
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Eth clima heired ei, possiblament, er unic vertadèr perilh damb eth quau pòden auer de bregar es pòc premanidi.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Se visitatz Groenlàndia enes sasons heiredes (en tot considerar que quant mès apròp deth nòrd, mès baisha serà era temperatura), ei cruciau portar-se pro ròba d'abric.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Es longui dies der ostiu pòden comportar problèmes tà dormir çò de sufisent e causar d'auti problèmes de salut restacadi.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Pendent er ostiu, tanben cau protegir-se des mosquits deth nòrd, pr'amor que, encara que non transmeten cap malautia, pòden èster fòrça irritants.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Maugrat qu'era economia de Sant Francisco ei restacada ar hèt d'èster ua atraccion toristica a nivèu globau, era economia ei diversificada.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Es sectors d'aucupacion mès destacadi son es servicis professionaus, era administracion, es finances, es activitats comerciaus e eth torisme.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Er hèt de que sigue evocada damb freqüéncia en cançons, pellicules, òbres de literatura e ena cultura populara a contribuït a qu'era ciutat e es sòns monuments siguen famosi a nivèu mondiau.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Damb ua grana varietat de hotèls, restaurants e installacions entà convencions de prumèr nivèu, Sant Francisco a desvolopat ua grana infrastructura toristica.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Atau madeish, Sant Francisco ei ua des milhors ciutats d'EE. UU. a on trapar d'auti tipes de gastronomia asiatica, coma era de Corèa, Tailàndia, Índia e Japon.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Eth viatge tà Walt Disney World ei, entà fòrça familhes des Estats Units, ua grana pelegrinacion.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Era visita «tipica» consistís en volar ar Aeropòrt Internacionau d'Orlando, préner un autobús cap a un hotèl laguens deth complèxe de Disney, passar ua setmana sense gésser des installacions e tornar tà casa.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Existissen infinites variantes possibles, mès açò ei çò qu'era majoria dera gent vò díder quan parle d' «anar a Disneylàndia».
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Fòrça des entrades disponibles en hilat, en pagines web de subastes coma eBay o Craigslist, son entrades de diuèrsi dies, usades parciaument.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Maugrat èster ua practica fòrça abituau, en Disney ei proïbida: es entrades son intransferibles.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Ei de besonh compdar damb un permís d'excursion entà poder acampar peth dejós  dera aurèra deth Gran Canon.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Damb era finalitat de protegir eth canon, es permisi son limitadi e se poderàn sollicitar sonque eth prumèr dia de cada mes e quate mesi abans deth mes d'inici.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Atau, un permís d'excursion entà quinsevolh data de mai, demorarà disponible er 1 de gèr.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Es espacis des zònes mès visitades, coma eth Bright Angel Campground, qu'ei ath costat de Phantom Ranch, soent s'aumplissen damb es sollicituds qu'arriben eth prumèr dia disponible entà hèr resèrves.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Existís un nombre limitat de permisi, reservadi entàs sollicituds d'accès a pè, que se liuren per orde d'arribada.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ua fantastica forma de contemplar tota era beresa dera region deth sud d'Africa ei entrar en automobil, çò que permeterà accedir a lòcs dehòra des rotes toristiques abituaus.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Açò se pòt hèr en un automobil comun damb ua planificacion detalhada. Totun, çò de mès recomanable ei hè'c en un 4x4; ath delà, i a fòrça lòcs as que sonque se i pòt accedir damb un 4x4 d'arròdes elevades.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: En planificar eth vòste viatge, ajatz en consideracion que, maugrat qu'Africa deth Sud ei estable, non toti es païsi que l'entornegen ac son.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Es requisits e còsti entà obtier eth visat depeneràn deth país d'a on provietz e, ath delà, càmbien de país a país.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ath delà, cada país a leis pròpries que determinen quini articles d'emergéncia an de trobar-se laguens der automobil.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ei ua ciutat en oèst de Zimbabwe, en tot passar era termièra damb Livingstone, Zambia, e apròp de Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Era ciutat se place ath costat des cascades, que son eth sòn principau atractiu, mès aguesta coneishuda destinacion toristica tanben aufrís, autant a aventurèrs coma a viatgèrs, un gran nombre d'opcions entà ua estada mès longa.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: En epòca de precipitacions (de noveme a març), eth cabau d'aigua creisherà e es cascades seràn mès impressionantes.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Segur que vos banharatz se trauessatz eth pònt o caminatz pes sinuosi camins propèrs as cascades.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Per un aute costat, ei justament a causa der anautit volum d'aigua qu'es vòstes vistes as cascades reaus se veiràn tapoades per tota era aigua!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Eth cavòt de Tutankamon (KV62). Eth cavòt KV62 pòt considerar-se eth mès famós ena Val des Reis, scenari dera descubèrta per Howard Carter, en 1922, deth lèu intacte enterrament reau deth joen faraon.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Totun, comparat damb era majoria des auti cavòts reaus, eth de Tutankamon non merite èster visitat, pr'amor qu'ei fòrça mès petit e damb ua decoracion limitada.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Qui sigue interessat en observar es damatges dera mòmia causadi pendent es assagi d'extrèir-la deth sarcofag se deceberie, dat que sonque son visibles eth cap e es espatles.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Actuaument, es jòies deth cavòt non se tròben aquiu, pr'amor qu'an estat trasladades ath Musèu Egipcian, en Eth Caire.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Entàs visitants damb pòc temps serie convenent qu'ac invertissen en un aute lòc.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom. Ei un temple bastit ena cima d'ua montanha entath torn de finaus deth sègle IX, pendent eth reiaume de Yasovarman, a 12 quilomètres ath sud de Siem Reap.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Era atmosfèra ombrivòla deth temple e era vista deth lac Tonle Sap hèn qu'er ascens peth tucolet age era sua recompensa.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Pòt organizar-se ua profitosa combinacion entre ua visita ar endret e ua passejada en vaishèth peth lac.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Ei de besonh eth passe d'Angkor entà accedir ath temple, per açò, non vos desbrembetz eth vòste passapòrt quan vagegatz a Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Encara que Jerusalem ei era ciutat principau e de major mida d'Israel, era majoria des auti païsi e es Nacions Unides non l'arreconeishen coma tau.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Era legendària ciutat enes Montanhes de Judèa a ua incredibla istòria millenària.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Es tres cultes monoteïstes ; açò ei, eth Judaïsme, eth Cristianisme e er Islam, la considèren tèrra santa e foncione coma sedença espirituau, religiosa e culturau.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Peth significat religiós dera ciutat e, en particular, un bon nombre de lòcs deth casc antic que seguissen en pè a dia d'aué, Jerusalem ei ua des destinacions toristiques mès populares d'Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Existissen fòrça lòcs istorics, arqueologics e culturaus en Jerusalem, ath delà de vibranti e concorrudi centres comerciaus, bars e restaurants.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Eqüator exigís qu'es ciutadans provenenti de Cuba, agen arrecebut ua carta d'invitacion abans d'entrar en país per aeropòrts internacionaus o lòcs d'admission enes termières.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Aguesta carta a d'èster certificada peth Ministèri de Relacions Exteriores d'Eqüator e a de complir cèrti requisits.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Er objectiu d'aguesti requisits ei proporcionar ua circulacion migratòria organizada entre andús païsi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Qui provengue de Cuba e compde damb ua carta verda des EE. UU. a de presentar-se deuant un consolat eqüatorian entà que se li autrege era exempcion d'aguest requisit.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: S'exigís qu'era vigéncia deth sòn passapòrt s'alongue per aumens 6 mesi mès dempús des sues dates de viatge. Se requerís, ath delà, que compde damb un bilhet de viatge barrat d'anada e de tornada, damb era fin de verificar era extension dera sua estada.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Es excursions son mès economiques entà grops de mès persones, atau que, s'ès solet o damb un unic amic, procuratz conéisher gent e formar un grop de quate a sies entà obtier ua milhor tarifa per cadun.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Totun, açò non vos aurie de preocupar guaire, pr'amor que, damb freqüéncia, es toristes se barregen entà completar es coches.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: En vertat, semble èster mès ua forma d'enganhar ara gent entà hèr-les a creir qu'an de pagar mès.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Desplegada en extrem nòrd de Machu Picchu, se place impausanta aguesta montanha, damb freqüéncia, eth paisatge de hons de fòrça fotografies des roïnes.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Des de baish resulte un shinhau impausanta, era pujada ei arribenta e complicada, mès era majoria de persones damb un estat fisic rasonable aurien de poder hèr-la en apruprètz 45 menutes.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Es gradons de pèira s'estien ath long de lèu tot eth camin e, enes parts mès arribentes, i a cables d'acèr tà hèr de supòrt.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Totun, premanitz-vos entara manca d'aire e vigilatz enes parts mès arribentes, mès sustot se i a umitat, dat que pòden tornar-se perilhoses rapidament.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ena part superiora se tròbe ua tuta petita que cau trauessar. Ei fòrça baisha e estreta.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Es lòcs e era vida sauvatja des Galàpagos s'obsèrven milhor en vaishèth, atau coma ac hec Charles Darwin en 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Mès de 60 creuèrs navèguen sus es aigües de Galàpagos e era sua capacitat vàrie entre 8 e 100 passatgèrs.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Era majoria des persones resèrven eth sòn lòc damb fòrça anticipacion, pr'amor qu'es vaishèths sòlen aumplir-se en sason nauta.
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Procuratz assegurar-vos qu'er agent que vos hèsque era resèrva compde damb coneishença especializada des Galàpagos e age un bon coneishement d'ua grana varietat de vaishèths en aguesta destinacion.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Açò assegurarà qu'es vòstes preferéncies o limitacions personaus coïncidisquen damb eth vaishèth mès adequat.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Abans dera arribada des espanhòus en sègle XVI, eth nòrd chilenc ère de domeni inca, mentre qu'es indigènes araucans (mapuches) residien en centre e sud deth país.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Es mapuches tanben sigueren ua des darrères tribús americanes independentes, que non demorèren absorbides per complèt peth domeni dera lengua espanhòla, dempús dera independéncia de Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Tot e qu'era independéncia de Chile siguec declarada en 1810 (en plea Guèrra deth Francés, que deishèc a Espanha sense un govèrn centrau operatiu pendent dus ans), eth trionf decisiu contra es espanhòus non arribèc enquia 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republica Dominicana ei un país deth Carib qu'aucupe era mitat orientau dera ièrla Era Espanhòla, era quau compartís damb Haití.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ath delà des sues plages de sable blanc e des sòns paisatges de montanha, eth país acuelh era ciutat europèa mès anciana d'America, qu'ara forme part de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Es prumèrs poblants dera ièrla sigueren es taïnos e es galibis; aguesti darrèri, que parlauen era lengua arauaca, auien arribat ena ièrla apruprètz en an 10 000 a. C.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Pòqui ans dempús dera arribada des exploradors europèus, es conquistadors espanhòus redusiren era poblacion de taïnos de manèra significativa.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Segontes Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tractat des Índies), es colons provenenti d'Espanha assassinèren ath torn de cent mil taïnos entre 1492 e 1498.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin dera Union. Aguest lòc se bastic coma claustre d'un convent deth sègle XVII, deth quau sonque se' n consèrve era bastissa deth Temple de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ara foncione coma era plaça centrau, a on tostemp passen causes, autant de dia coma de net.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Eth jardin ei entornejat per diuèrsi restaurants e, pes tardes e pes nets, se sòlen aufrir concèrts gratuïts des dera glorieta centrau.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Eth Carreron deth Punet: Dus balcons que se separen per sonque 69 cm que son era origina d'ua anciana legenda romantica.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Quauqui mainatges vos condaràn era istòria en escambi d'ua petita estrea.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Era ièrla de Bowen ei un coneishut viatge entà hèr en un dia o en ua dimenjada e qu'includís anar en caiac, caminades, botigues, restaurants e mès.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: En Howe Sound, exactament ath costat de Vancouver, se tròbe aguesta autentica comunitat ara quau se i pòt arribar facilament en taxis aquatics programadi que gessen des de Granville Island, en centre de Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Entà qui gaudís damb es activitats en exterior, ua excursion peth corredor deth Sea to Sky non pòt mancar.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler, que se tròbe a ua ora e mieja en automobil des de Vancouver, ei costosa mès coneishuda pes Jòcs Olimpics d'Iuèrn de 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Pendent er iuèrn, gauditz deth milhor esquí en America deth Nòrd e, en ostiu, experimentatz er autentic ciclisme de montanha.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: S'an de reservar es permisi damb anticipacion. Entà passar era net en Sirena, s'exigís compdar damb un permís.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Era unica estacion d'agents forestaus qu'aufrís lotjament en abitacions e minjars, ath delà deth camping, ei Sirena. En La Leona, San Pedrillo e Los Patos sonque aufrissen acampar, sense servici de minjar.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Se pòden reservar permisi entà estacionar dirèctament ena estacion d'agents forestaus de Puerto Jiménez, mès non accèpten targetes de crèdit.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Eth Servici deth Parc (MINAE) non concedís permisi d'accès damb mès d'un mes d'anticipacion ara data d'arribada.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Cafenet El Sol aufrís un servici de resèrves per 30 dòlars des EUA o 10 dòlars pes abonaments d'un dia; mès detalhs, ena pagina de Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Es ièrles Cook, en Polinesia, Ocean Pacific, constituïssen un estat insular en associacion volontària damb Naua Zelanda.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Se tracte d'un archipèl format per 15 ièrles que se distribuïssen en ua superfícia oceanica de 2.2 milions de km2.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Pr'amor que compartissen era madeisha zòna orària que Hawaii, a viatges aguestes ièrles son aperades «Hawaii d'Oceania».
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Tot e que son mès petites, a quauqui visitants dera tresau edat les arrebrembe a Hawaii, abans de que se convertisse en un estat, sense es grani hotèls toristics e d'auti bastiments.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Enes ièrles Cook non i a cap ciutat, e son formades per 15 ièrles. Es mès importantes son Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Actuaument, era aufèrta de lotjament e esdejoar de luxe s'a tornat, enes païsi deth prumèr mon, en ua classa de forma d'art.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: En extrem superior, es B&B competissen, sustot, en dus servicis: eth lhet e er esdejoar.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Donques, enes establiments mès exclusius d'aguest tipe, un poderà trobar-se damb es linçòs mès luxosi, dilhèu ua vànua confeccionada a man o un lhet ancian.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Entar esdejoar pòden servir-se delícies de sason regionaus o era especialitat der anfitrion.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Er scenari poderie èster compausat per ua bastissa istorica damb mòbles antics, jardins ben suenhadi e ua piscina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Pujar ath veïcul e iniciar un long viatge per carretèra a un atractiu intrinsèc ena sua simplicitat.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A diferéncia des veïculs de mida superior, ei probable que dejà t'ages familharizat damb era conduccion deth tòn coche e ne coneishes es limitacions.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Installar ua tenda en un terren privat o en un pòble sense importar era sua mida pòt atrèir facilament era atencion de manèra non desirada.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En tot resumir, eth coche ei ua grana opcion tà hèr un viatge per carretèra, mès en si madeish non sòl èster ua forma d'«acampar».
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Era acampada en coche ei factible s'as ua forgoneta, ua berlina, un coche esportiu  utilitari o ua camioneta damb sètis inclinables.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Quauqui hotèls an un legat dera edat daurada deth trèn a vapor e des transatlantics, que daten d'abans dera Dusau Guèrra Mondiau, en sègle XIX o a principis deth sègle XX.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: En aguesti hotèls se lotjauen es rics e famosi deth moment e, soent, gaudien de boni minjars e vida nocturna.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Es accessòris vintage, era manca des comoditats modèrnes e ua cèrta antiquitat sofisticada tanben formen part deth sòn caractèr.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Tot e que sòlen èster proprietats privades, a viatges lòtgen a caps d'estat e a d'auti mandataris.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viatgèr damb molti sòs poderie considerar hèr un viatge ath torn deth mon en avion, damb pauses entà lotjar-se en fòrça d'aguesti hotèls.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Un hilat d'escambi de lotjament consistís en ua organizacion que connècte as viatgèrs damb es residents des destinacions que visitaràn.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Tà junher-se a un hilat atau, en generau sonque cau ramplir un qüestionari, encara que quauqui hilats aufrissen o demanen verificacion addicionau.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dempús se proporcione un listrat des anfitrions disponibles, imprés o en linha, qu'a viatges compde damb referéncies e comentaris de d'auti viatgèrs.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing se fondèc en gèr de 2004, dempús de qu'un programaire informatic cridat Casey Fenton artenhesse un vòl de baish còst tà anar a Islàndia, mès non trobèsse cap de lòc a on lotjar-se.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Escriuec per corrèu electronic a alumnes dera universitat dera zòna e arrecebec un pialèr d'aufèrtes de lotjament gratuïtes.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Es aubèrges sòlen lotjar a gent joena (un òste tipic a ua vintea d'ans), mès soent se pòden trapar viatgèrs majors.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Es familhes damb hilhs son quauquarren que non se trape soent, mès bèri aubèrges les accèpten en crambes privades.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Era ciutat de Pequin, en China, serà anfitriona des Jòcs Olimpics d'Iuèrn en 2022, çò que la convertirà ena prumèra ciutat en auer acuelhut autant es jòcs d'ostiu coma es d'iuèrn.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing serà anfitriona des ceremònies de dubertura e clausura, atau coma des eveniments sus gèu en espacis barradi.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: D'auti eveniments d'esquí s'amiaràn a tèrme ena zòna d'esquí de Taizicheng, en Zhangjiakou, que se tròbe a uns 220 quilomètres (140 miles) de Pequin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Era majoria des temples celèbren un hestivau annau que comence entre finaus de noveme e entà miei mai, e que depen deth calendari annau de cada temple.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Era majoria des hestivaus deth temple se celèbren coma part der anniversari deth temple o der anniversari dera divinitat que presidís, o quinsevolh aute eveniment associat damb eth temple.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Ua professon regular d'elefants adornadi, era orquèstra deth temple e d'autes hestivitats hèn qu'es hestivaus deth temple de Kerala siguen fòrça interessants.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Ua Hèira Mondiau (soent cridada Exposicion Mondiau, o simplament Expo) ei un gran hestivau internacionau d'arts e sciéncies.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Es païsi que i participen exibissen es sues mòstres artistiques e educatives en pabelhons nacionaus, entà mostrar problèmes mondiaus o era istòria e cultura deth sòn país.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Es eveniments internacionaus d'Orticultura son amassades especializades qu'expòsen aparadors floraus, jardins botanics e tot aquerò restacat damb es plantes.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Tot e qu'en teoria se celèbren un còp ar an (tostemp que sigue en païsi desparièrs), ena practica non ei atau.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Aguesti eveniments sòlen durar de tres a sies mesi e s'amien a tèrme en lòcs d'ua superfícia d'aumens 50 ectares.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: A trauès des ans, s'an emplegat nombrosi formats de pellicules. Er estandard, de 35 mm (negatius de 36 per 24 mm), ei eth mès abituau.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: En generau, se pòt reposar facilament se s'acabe e aufrís ua resolucion similara as  DSLR actuaus.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Existissen aparelhs de vidèo de cinèma damb format miei qu'empleguen un format de 6 per 6 cm, mès especificament, un negatiu de 56 per 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Açò permet lèu eth quadruple de resolucion que damb un negatiu de 35 mm (3136 mm2 contra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Un des tèmes mès desafiadors entàs fotografs ei era vida silvèstre, e requerís ua combinacion de bona sòrt, paciéncia, experiéncia e bon equipament.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Ei comun qu'era fotografia dera vida sauvatja non s'avalore. Totun, coma succedís en aguesta disciplina en generau, ua imatge vau mès que mil paraules.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Soent, entara fotografia dera vida silvèstre ei de besonh utilizar un teleobjectiu long, encara que cau d'auti tipes de lents entà objectius coma ua ramada d'audèths o ua creatura fòrça petita.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Nombroses espècies exotiques son dificils de trapar e ei abituau qu'es parcs impòsen restriccions en çò que tanh a hèr fotografies damb objectius comerciaus.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Existissen creatures sauvatges timides e d'autes agressives. Er entorn pòt èster heired, caud o ostil.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: En tota era planeta, existissen mès de 5000 lengües diuèrses, des quaus mès de vint son parlades per 50 milions de persones, o mès.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: En generau, aquerò que se comunique per escrit ei mès simple de compréner que çò que se ditz de forma orau. Clar exemple d'açò ei eth cas des adreces, que fòrça còps son dificils de prononciar de manèra intelligible.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: I a molti païsi a on parlen damb totau fluïdesa er anglés en tot eth territòri, e en molti d'auti podetz demorar un coneishement limitat, en particular entre es mès joeni.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imagina-te, per exemple, a un de Manchester, un de Boston, un de Jamaica e un de Sídney seigudi en ua taula en tot compartir un sopar en un restaurant de Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Se deleiten mutuament damb istòries des sues ciutats nataus, narrades damb es sòns diuèrsi accents e eth sòn argòt locau.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Generaument, era forma mès economica d'alimentar-se ei en tot crompar eth minjar enes supermercats. Totun, se codinar non ei possible, es opcions se redusissen as minjars precodinadi.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Es supermercats arreceben cada viatge ua major varietat de minjar premanit. Quauqu'uns, enquia aufrissen un microondes o d'auti mejans entà cauhar eth minjar.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: En quauqui païsi o tipes de botigues, existís aumens un restaurant, mèslèu informau, damb prètzi economics.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Hètz còpies dera vòsta polissa e amiatz-les damb vosati, amassa damb era informacion de contacte dera vòsta companhia d'assegurances.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Aguesti an de contier donades dera asseguradora coma eth corrèu electronic e es numèros de telefon entà picar des der estrangèr e obtier atau assessorament o autorizacions e realizar reclamacions.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Sauvatz ua auta còpia en equipatge e ua auta digitau (enviatz-la per corrèu electronic coma archiu adjunt o pujatz-la ara «broma»).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: En cas de viatjar damb un ordinador portatil o ua tauleta, sauva ua còpia ena memòria o en disc (tà que s'i pogue accedir sense servici d'Internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Tanben liura còpies dera polissa e des donades de contacte ad aqueri damb qui viatges e a familhaus o amics disposadi a ajudar.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Es elans (tanben cridadi oapitís) non an ua natura agressiva, totun, se defeneràn se se senten menaçadi.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: S'era gent non percep qu'es elans son potenciaument agressius, poderien apropar-se massa e meter-se en perilh.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Beuetz alcoòl damb moderacion. Er alcoòl afècte a cada persona de manèra desparièra e conéisher eth vòste pròpri limit ei molt important.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Era ingestion excessiva d'alcoòl pòt causar problèmes cronics de salut coma damatge epatic e enquia ceguèra e era mòrt. Eth perilh potenciau s'incremente damb eth consum d'alcoòl elaborat de forma illegau.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Enes begudes alcoòliques illegaus i pòden auer diuèrses impureses perilhoses, coma eth metanòl, capaç de provocar ceguèra o enquiara mòrt, encara que s'ingerisque pòca quantitat.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Es lunetes pòden èster mès economiques en un país estrangèr, en particular en aqueri de baishi ingrèssi a on es còsti de produccion son inferiors.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Consideratz era opcion de realizar-vos un examen ocular en vòste país d'origen, sustot s'ac corbís era assegurança, e dempús amiar era prescripcion medicau entà presentar-la en quinsevolh auta destinacion deth mon.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Es montures de mèrques de nauta qualitat que pòden aquerir-se en aguesta zòna pòden presentar dus inconvenents: quauqu'ues pòden èster imitacions e es reaument importades pòden èster mès costoses qu'en país d'origina.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Eth cafè ei un des productes basics que mès se comercialize a nivèu mondiau e ei probable que pogatz trapar fòrça varietats ena vòsta region.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Totun, i a fòrça formes desparières de préner cafè en tota era planeta, que meriten èster provades.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Eth barranquisme consistís en anar enquiath hons d'un barranc, que pòt èster shut o plen d'aigua.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Eth barranquisme combine elements dera natacion, dera escalada e deth saut, mès exigís relativament pòc entrenament o estat fisic entà començar (se se compare, per exemple, damb era escalada de montanha, eth submarinisme o er esquí aupin).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Er excursionisme ei ua activitat que se practique ar aire liure e que tracte de hèr caminades per entorns naturaus, soent per rotes de senderisme.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Es caminades d'un dia impliquen des de distàncies de mens d'ua mila enquia recorruts mès longui, que poguen realizar-se en un dia.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Entà ua excursion d'un dia per un camin simple cau pòca preparacion e quinsevolh persona moderadament en forma pòt hèr-la.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Es familhes damb mainatges petiti pòden necessitar mès preparacion, mès un dia en exterior ei facilament accessible damb nenons e mainatges en edat preescolara.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A nivèu mondiau, existissen lèu 200 organizacions de torisme en foncionament. Era majoria opère de manèra independenta.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Go! Running Tours, successora de Globau Running Tours, connècte en quate continents a dotzenes de provedidors de corredors ar aire liure.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Damb origina en Running Tours Barcelona, d'aguesta ciutat, e eth Running Copenhagen, d'aguesta auta, rapidament se li junheren eth Running Tours Prague, damb basa en Praga, e d'auti mès.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Son fòrça es ahèrs a considerar abans e pendent un viatge a quinsevolha destinacion.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Quan viatges, non demores qu'es causes siguen coma «en casa».  I aurà cèrtes diferéncies en causes coma es modaus, era legislacion, eth minjar, eth trafic, eth lotjament, es normes, er idiòma, entre d'auti.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Açò a d'auer-se tostemp present a fin d'estauviar-se decepcions e, enquia quauque desplaser producte des formes locaus de hèr es causes.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Es agéncies de viatges an existit des deth sègle XIX. Generaument, un agent de viatges ei ua bona opcion entà cassi en qu'eth viatgèr non compde damb experiéncia prèvia en ahèrs coma era natura, era cultura, er idiòma o es païsi de baishi ingrèssi.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Tot e qu'era majoria des agéncies son disposades a assumir lèu tota sòrta de resèrves tradicionaus, fòrça agents s'especializen en cèrt tipe de viatges, rengs de pressupòsti o destinacions especifiques.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Pòt èster convenent contactar a un agent que soent hèsque resèrves de viatges similars ath vòste.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Consultatz es viatges promoigudi per agents. Pòt hèr-se autant en ua pagina web coma ena veirina d'un negòci.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Se vòs conéisher eth mon damb pògui sòs, sigue per besonh, estil de vida o coma un rèpte, existissen quauques manères entà hè'c.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Se dividissen, en esséncia, en dues classes: es que trabalhen mentre viatgen e es que procuren restringir es despenes. Aguest article tracte sus era dusau opcion.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Qui accèpte relegar era comoditat, eth temps e era previsibilitat en favor d'amendrir es còsti practicament a zèro, que veigue viatges de pressupòst minim.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Eth conselh assumís qu'es viatgèrs non panen, ne viòlen era proprietat privada, ne participen en mercat illegau, ne mendiquen, ne tanpòc explòten a d'autes persones en benefici pròpri.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Generaument, un lòc de contraròtle d'immigracion ei era prumèra arturada en descéner d'ua aeronau, vaishèth o d'aute miei de transpòrt.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: En cèrti trèns que trauessen termières, se realizen inspeccions mentre eth trèn ei en moviment, e auetz d'auer ua identificacion valida en embarcar en un d'eri.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Enes trèns nocturns, eth conductor pòt arremassar es passapòrts entà non interrómper eth sòn.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Eth registre ei ua exigéncia addicionau entath procès deth visat. En quauqui païsi,  cau qu'enregistretz era vòsta preséncia e era adreça deth vòste lotjament damb es autoritats locaus.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Entà artenhe'c, poderie èster de besonh ramplir un formulari deuant era policia locau o visitar eth burèu d'immigracion.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: En fòrça païsi damb ua lei d'aguest tipe, es hotèls locaus se n'encuedaràn de hèr eth registre (asseguratz-vos de demanà'c).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: En d'auti cassi, sonque a d'enregistrar-se qui non se lòtge en lotjaments toristics. Totun, açò hè qu'era lei sigue fòrça mès incèrta, atau que cau descorbi'c damb antelacion.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: A cargue deth dessenh e deth bastiment d'edificacions, era arquitectura d'un lòc sòl èster ua atraccion toristica en si madeisha.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Fòrça bastisses son reaument polides tara vista e eth panorama des d'aqueres de grana nautor o damb hièstres estrategicament plaçades, pòt èster d'ua beresa digna de contemplar.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Era arquitectura coincidís significativament damb d'autes disciplines, coma ne son era planificacion urbana, era enginheria civiu, er art decoratiu, eth dessenh d'interiors e eth dessenh deth paisatge.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Dada era grana distància qu'existís enquia fòrça des pòbles, non traparatz guaira vida nocturna se non viatjatz enquia Albuquerque o Santa Fe.
