text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Totun, era majoria des casinos abans referidi servissen begudes e diuèrsi d'eri aufrissen espectacles de prumèra categoria (principaument es mès grani, plaçadi ath torn d'Albuquerque e Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Es muraus o chimarratges que se realizen sense qu'arrés ac demane, arreceben eth nòm de grafits.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Encara qu'ei luenh d'èster un fenomèn modèrn, era majoria des persones generaument ac restaquen damb eth vandalisme en proprietats publiques e privades per part de joeni en tot usar pentura en aerosòl.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Totun, actuaument existissen artistes deth grafit arreconeishudi, se celèbren eveniments d'aguesta disciplina e i a murs «legaus». En aguest contèxte, es pentures de grafit pòden, soent, semblar-se mès a òbres d'art qu'a chimarratges illegibles.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un plat tipic Hangi se premanís laguens d'un clòt caud en solèr.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Molti des lòcs de Rotorua aufrissen hangi geotermics, mentre que se pòden préner d'auti hangi en Christchurch, Wellington e quinsevolh aute lòc.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail compde damb dus tipes de trèns suburbans en Ciutat deth Cap e zònes propères: MetroPlus (tanben coneishut coma Prumèra Classa) e Metro (aperada Tresau Classa).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus aufrís mès comoditat e ei mens concurrut, encara qu'ei un shinhau mès car. Totun, contunhe en tot èster mès economic qu'es bilhets regulars de mètro en Euròpa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Toti es trèns an vagons MetroPlus e Metro; es prumèrs tostemp se placen ath finau deth trèn mès propdan a Ciutat deth Cap.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Amiar causes des auti: Jamès pèrdes de vista eth tòn equipatge, sustot quan crotzes termières internacionaus.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Voz podetz trapar en tot èster utilizadi coma transportadors de psicofarmacs sense qu'ac sapiatz, çò que vos portarie molti problèmes.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Açò includís demorar en hilèra, pr'amor que, en quinsevolh moment, e sense prèvi avís, pòden usar-se es cans detectors de drògues.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Quauqui païsi impòsen puniments excessivament sevèrs, damb senténcies de preson de mès de 10 ans o era mòrt, en tot includir as qui cometen un delicte per prumèr viatge.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Er equipatge que non s'aten se torne objectiu de panatòris e, ath madeish temps, atrè era atencion des autoritats, que se tròben atentes deuant possibles menaces de bomba.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: En tòn país d'origina, producte d'aguesta permanenta exposicion as gèrmes locaus, ei molt probable que ja sigues immune ada eri.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Maugrat açò, en d'autes parts deth mon a on non ès familharizat damb era fauna bacteriologica, i a granes possibilitats de qu'ages problèmes.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Atau madeish, en climes damb temperatures mès anautides, es bactèries se desvolopen damb major velocitat e artenhen víuer mès temps dehòra deth còs.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: D'aquiu sorgiren es caganhes deth viatgèr coma “er estomac de Delhi”, “era malediccion deth faraon” e era “venjança de Monteczuma” e moltes d'autes variants.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Dera madeisha manèra que passe damb es problèmes respiratòris en climes mès heireds, es problèmes intestinaus en climes caudi son fòrça abituaus e, encara que son molèsti, ena majoria des cassi non son reaument perilhosi.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: S'ei eth sòn prumèr viatge a un país en via de desvolopament o a un lòc que jamès as anat, non subestimes eth possible impacte culturau.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Mès d'un viatgèr experimentat e capaç s'a vist superat pes nauetats qu'impliquen es viatges a païsi en via de desvolopament, a on fòrça petiti ajustaments culturaus pòden acumular-se rapidament.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Sustot pendent es prumèri dies, pensa ena possibilitat de gastar es sòs en hotèls, minjar e servicis de bona qualitat e d'estil occidentau, entà ajudar-te a aclimatar-te.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Non dromitz en un matalàs o un matalasset en tèrra en zònes a on non sigatz familharizadi damb era fauna locau.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Se planeges acampar, pòrta un catre o un amac entà sauvar era distància damb es sèrps, es escorpins e fauna pariona.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Aumplís eth tòn larèr damb un exquisit cafè peth maitin e damb un shinhau de camamilha relaxant pera net.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Quan ès en casa tua de vacances, as temps tà gaudir e dedicar ues menutes mès entà codinar un plat especiau.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Se t'animes a experimentar ua major aventura, profita era oportunitat d'esprémer o de barrejar chucs de frutes:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Dilhèu descorbisses ua beguda entar esdejoar facil de premanir entà quan tornes ara tua rotina abituau.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se viues en ua ciutat damb ua cultura variada de begudes, visita bars o pubs des vesiats que normaument non visites.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Entà qui desconeish era terminologia medicau, «infecciós» e «contagiós» non signifiquen çò de madeish.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: S'apère malautia infecciosa ad aquera qu'ei provocada per un patogèn, per exemple un virus, ua bactèria, un fongus o d'aute organisme parasitari.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: S'apère malautia contagiosa ad aquera que se transmet damb facilitat en trobar-se apròp de quauquarrés infectat.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Es autoritats de nombrosi païsi exigissen era vacunacion contra diuèrses malauties as viatgèrs qu'entren o as residents que gessen.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Soent, aguesti requisits depenen des païsi qu'eth viatgèr age visitat o age era intencion de visitar.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Ua des principaus auantatges de Charlotte, en Carolina deth Nòrd, ei qu'aufrís un bon nombre d'opcions de nauta qualitat entà familhes.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Es residents d'autes regions soent se referissen a qu'era bona vida familhau ei era arrason principau entà trasladar-se aquiu e, fòrça viatges, es visitants descorbissen qu'ei facil gaudir dera ciutat damb mainatges.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Era varietat d'alternatives pensades entà mainatges en Uptown Charlotte a creishut de forma vertiginosa pendent es darrèri 20 ans.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: En Charlotte, non ei comun qu'es familhes prenguen taxis, mès pòden èster d'utilitat en cèrtes situacions.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: S'aplique un recargue se son mès de dus passatgèrs, de manèra qu'aguesta opcion poderie èster mès cara que çò qu'ei de besonh.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Era Antartida ei era zòna mès heireda dera planeta e entornege ath Pòl Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Es visites toristiques an prètzi anautidi, ath delà de que requerissen bones condicions fisiques e sonque se pòden hèr en ostiu, entre noveme e hereuèr, son molt limitades ara ara peninsula, es ièrles e era mar de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un parelh de milenats de trabalhadors viuen aciu en ostiu, en ues quate dotzenes de bases, majoritariament plaçades en aguestes regions, mès sonque un petit nombre i demore pendent er iuèrn.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: En sòn interior, era Antartida consistís en un altiplan desèrt revestit per entre 2 e 3 quilomètres de gèu.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: De temps en temps, s'amien a tèrme excursions aerianes especializades que van tar interior, entà practicar aupinisme o arribar enquiath Pòl, a on i a ua basa molt grana.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Era Trauèssa deth Pòl Sud (o Autopista) ei un camin de 1600 km des dera basa McMurdo, ena mar de Ross, enquiath Pòl.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Se tracte de nhèu compactada, damb henedures aumplides e senhalizades damb drapèus. Sonque pòden circular per aquiu tractors especiaus, en tot cargar luges damb combustible o d'auti subministraments.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Aguesti non son massa agils, per çò qu'eth camin a de dar un long recorrut en tot entornejar es montanhes Transantartiques entà arténher er altiplan.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: En epòca iuernau, era causa mès abituau d'accident son es carretères, es paviments (trepaders) e, en particular, es gradons qu'esguitlen.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ei essenciau compdar damb cauçat damb sòla apropriada. Es sabates d'ostiu generaument esguitlen fòrça en gèu e era nhèu, enquia i a bòtes d'iuèrn que non son avientes.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Cau qu'eth patron age ua prigondor apropriada, de 5 mm (1/5 poces) o superiora, e qu'eth materiau sigue pro trende en temperatures baishes.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: I a bòtes damb talons e existissen accessòris damb talons entà condicions de resquilhament, que s'adapten a lèu quinsevolh cauçat, autant entàs talons coma tàs sòles.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Cau qu'es talons siguen baishi e amples. Soent, s'escampilhe sable, graua o sau (clorur de calci) sus es carretères o camins a fin d'obtier ua milhor aderéncia.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Es lauegi non son quauquarren anormau; es còstes arribentes unicament resistissen cèrta quantitat de nhèu, per çò qu'er excès queirà en forma de botassi.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Eth problèma ei qu'era nhèu ei apegant, motiu peth quau requerís ua possada entà quèir, e un shinhau de nhèu que baishe pòt èster eth desencadenant dera rèsta.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: A viatges, eth factor desencadenant ei eth solei que delís era nhèu, d'auti còps, ei ua naua nheuada o d'auti eveniments naturaus, e soent, ei er èster uman.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Un tornado ei ua colomna giratòria d'aire a fòrça baisha pression que chuque er aire deth sòn torn tà laguens e tà naut.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Produsissen fòrti vents (soent de 100-200 miles/ora) e pòden lheuar objèctes pesadi en aire, en tot transportar-les mentre eth tornado se desplace.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Comencen coma embuts que baishen des bromalhs de tempèsta e se transformen en tornados quan entren en contacte damb eth solèr.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Es provedidors des VPN personaus, (hilats privadi virtuaus) son era opcion ideau entà evitar era censura politica e eth geofiltratge d'IP comerciau.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Son milhors qu'es servidors proxy per diuèrsi motius: per exemple, redirigissen tot eth trafic d'Internet e non sonque es http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Generaument, balhen ua major amplada de banda e milhor qualitat de servici. Son encriptadi e, gràcies ad açò, son mès dificils d'espiar.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Es enterpreses multimèdia mentissen repetidament sus era sua finalitat, en tot assegurar que servís tà «previer era pirateria».
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: De hèt, es còdis regionaus non an cap tipe d'efècte sus es còpies illegaus. Ua còpia identica d'un disc se reprodusirà sense problèmes enes madeishi dispositius a on se pogue reprodusir era originau.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Er objectiu actuau ei aufrir un major contraròtle a aguestes companhies sus es sòns mercats; se tracte de generar sòs.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Dat qu'es telefonades s'adrecen mejançant Internet, non cau qu'ages ua companhia telefonica plaçada aquiu a on viues o a on viatges.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Tanpòc auetz de besonh un numèro locau deth lòc a on viuetz; podetz arténher ua connexion a Internet per satellit enes zònes mès sauvatges de Chicken, en Alaska, e escuélher un numèro que confirme qu'ètz jos eth solei d'Arizòna.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Soent, cau crompar un numèro globau per separat tà perméter qu'es telefons XTC vos poguen picar. Era origina d'aguest numèro provòque ua diferéncia entàs persones que vos piquen.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplicacions de revirada de tèxte en temps reau: son aqueres que pòden generar, automaticament, revirades de fragments de tèxte complèts d'ua lengua a ua auta.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Entre aguest tipe d'aplicacions podem trobar quauques qu'enquia arreviren tèxtes en idiòmes estrangèrs de panèus o d'auti objèctes deth mon reau quan er usatgèr dirigís eth sòn telefon intelligent enquiàs objèctes.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Es motors de revirada an milhorat drasticament e ena actualitat, soent, aufrissen traduccions pro corrèctes (e estranh còp contengut sense sens); totun, cau anar damb compde, pr'amor qu'encara ei possible que s'enganhen.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Ua des principaus aplicacions en aguesta categoria ei Google Translate, que realize era traduccion sense connexion se se descarguen es donades dera lengua damb era quau  se trabalharà.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Possiblament, era manèra mès simpla e convenenta de navegar quan te trapes dehòra deth tòn país, ei installar aplicacions de navegacion GPS en tòn telefon intelligent.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Podetz estauviar sòs en tot crompar mapes naui entà GPS, un dispositiu GPS independent, o logar-ne un a ua empresa d'automobils.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Se non compdes damb ua connexion de donades entath tòn telefon, o se te manque cobertura, eth tòn rendement pòt èster limitat o nul.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Enes botigues d'aliments i a ua enorma e confusa varietat de targetes telefoniques de prepagament que pòden utilizar-se en telefons de pagament e telefons normaus.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Encara que lèu totes es targetes son valides entà picar a quinsevolh lòc, quauqu'ues balhen tarifes convenentes tà grops de païsi especifics.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Generaument, se pòt accedir ad aguesti servicis mejançant un numèro telefonic gratuït  damb eth quau ei possible comunicar-se des dera majoria des telefons, sense cap de còst.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Es normes dera fotografia normau son tanben d'aplicacion ar enregistrament de vidèos, e possiblament, enquia encara mès.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Se non se permet préner ua fotografia de quauquarren, alavetz non s'aurie de pensar en filmà'c.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Se s'utilize un dròn, s'a de verificar abans qué se pòt filmar e quini permisi o licéncies addicionaus s'an de besonh.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Encara que sigue legau ena tua region, non sòl èster ua bona idèa hèr a volar un dròn apròp d'un aeropòrt o peth dessús d'ua multitud.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Actuaument, es viatges en avion rarament se resèrven dirèctament damb era aerolinha, sense abans cercar e comparar prètzi.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: A viatges, un madeish vòl pòt auer prètzi fòrça desparièrs en diuèrsi lectors de contenguts, per çò que vau era pena comparar es resultats de recèrca e navegar en lòc web dera enterpresa abans de realizar era resèrva.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Encara que dilhèu no ages de besonh un visat entà estades cuertes en cèrtes destinacions se viatges coma torista o per negòcis, viatjar ad aguesti madeishi lòcs coma estudiant internacionau, generaument, implique ua estada mès esperlongada qu'ua visita ocasionau de caractèr toristic.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Normaument, entà demorar en quinsevolh país estrangèr pendent un periòde de temps long, calerà obtier un visat anticipadament.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Generaument, es visats d'estudiants impliquen requisits e procediments de sollicitud desparièrs d'aqueri visats normaus de torisme o negòcis.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Ena majoria des païsi cau ua carta d'aufèrta hèta pera institucion a on volgues estudiar e, ath delà, demostrar que compdes damb hons entà mantier-te pendent, aumens, eth prumèr an deth cors.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Verifica es requisits especifics damb era institucion e en burèu d'immigracion deth país a on desires estudiar.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Exceptat que sigues un diplomatic, trabalhar en estrangèr normaument implique auer de pagar impòsti sus era renda en país a on residisses.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Er impòst sus era renda ei organizat de forma desparièra enes diuèrsi estats e es taxes impositives e es categories vàrien fòrça entre païsi.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Existissen estats federaus, coma es Estats Units e Canadà, a on er impòst sus era renda regís autant a nivèu federau coma locau. Coma conseqüéncia, es taxes e categories pòden èster desparières segontes era region.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Encara qu'eth contraròtle d'immigracion sòl èster inexistent o sonque ua formalitat en arribar ath tòn país, eth contraròtle doanèr pòt èster un destorb.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Procuratz auer clar quini articles pòden entrar e quini non. Atau madeish, declaratz tot aquerò qu'excedisque es limits legaus.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Era manèra mès simpla de començar en negòci dera escritura sus viatges ei milhorar es aptituds en ua pagina web de blògs de viatges consolidada.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Dempús de que t'ages familharizat damb eth format e era edicion ena web, alavetz poderàs dessenhar eth tòn pròpri lòc web.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Hèr volontariat mentre se viatge ei ua forma extraordinària de mercar era diferéncia, mès non se tracte sonque de dar.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Víuer e èster volontari en un país estrangèr ei ua excellenta forma d'arribar a conéisher ua cultura diferenta, persones naues, apréner sus un madeish, auer un sens de perspectiva e, enquia aquerir abiletats naues.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Tanben poderie èster ua bona forma d'alongar eth pressupòst e perméter ua estada mès longa, pr'amor que fòrça trabalhs volontaris aufrissen lotjament e minjar, e quauqu'ns paguen ua petita remuneracion.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Es rotes navegables russes sigueren usades pes vikings entà dirigir-se ara Mar Nera e ara Mar Caspiana. Encara ei possible utilizar parts d'aguestes rotes. Consultatz se cau compdar damb autorizacions especiaus, çò qu'ei ua possibilitat, e poderien èster dificils d'obtier.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Er Ocean Artic ei estacat ara Mar Baltica a trauès deth Canau dera Mar Blanca-Baltica, per miei des lacs Onega e Ladoga e a Sant Petersborg, majoritàriament a trauès d'arrius e lacs.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Eth lac Onega tanben ei connectat damb eth Vòlga, de manèra qu'encara se pòt arribar ara Mar Caspiana en tot passar per Russia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Pòs èster segur de qu'un viatge arribes en pòrt, tot serà pro evident. Coneisheràs a d'auti autoestopistes deth vaishèth, que compartiràn era sua informacion damb tu.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Eth tòn prètzhèt serà, basicament, plaçar anoncis en tot aufrir era tua ajuda, recórrer es darses, apropar-te as persones que netegen es iòts, sajar de hèr contactes damb es marinèrs en bar, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Tractatz de parlar damb era major quantitat possibla de gent. Dempús d'un temps, toti vos coneisheràn e vos daràn indicacions coma quin vaishèth cerque quauquarrés.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Vos calerie escuélher damb atencion era vòsta companhia aeriana de viatgèr freqüent.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Encara que pogues pensar que çò de mès logic ei escuélher era companhia aeriana damb era que mès as viatjat, te cau saber qu'es beneficis aufridi sòlen èster desparièrs e que, a viatges, es punts de viatgèr pòden autrejar-te mès beneficis en ua auta aerolinha dera madeisha aliança.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Companhies aerianes coma Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways e Turkish Airlines an incrementat notablament es sòns vòls tà Africa e aufrissen connexions a fòrça des principaus ciutats deth continent, a milhor prètz que d'autes enterpreses europèes.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Des der an 2014, Turkish Airlines vòle a 39 destinacions de 30 païsi d'Africa.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: S'as temps de mès pendent eth viatge, calcula quant te còste en totau eth desplaçament a Africa en comparacion damb un torn peth mon.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Arrebremba includir es despenes addicionaus, es impòsti deth viatge, eth transpòrt terrèstre, etc. entà toti es lòcs que visites dehòra d'Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se vòs viatjar ath torn deth mon en tot volar integrament peth emisfèri sud, se redusiràn es tues opcions de vòls e destinacions pera manca de rotes transoceaniques.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Cap aliança aeriana trauèsse es tres oceans der emisfèri sud (e SkyTeam non ne corbís cap).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Totun, era Star Alliance ac corbís tot a excepcion deth Pacific Sud que s'esten des de Santiago de Chile enquia Tahití, qu'ei un vòl de LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Se voletz evitar eth Pacific Sud e era còsta occidentau d'America deth Sud, i a d'autes opcions ath delà d'aguest vòl (guardatz enjós).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: En 1994, era zòna deth Naut Karabakh, d'etnia armènia, d'Azerbaitjan, se lancèc ara luta contra es azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Damb eth supòrt d'Armenia, se formèc ua naua republica, encara que non ei ua nacion establida ne compde damb era reconeishença oficiau deth govèrn armèni.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Es ligams entre Armenia e Azerbaitjan seguissen afectadi pes diferéncies de caractèr diplomatic qu'existissen en aguesta region.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Eth Districte deth Canau (en neerlandés, Grachtengordel), en Amsterdam, ei eth popular barri deth sègle XVII que se desplegue ath torn de Binnenstad.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Eth barri complèt siguec declarat Patrimòni dera Umanitat pera Unesco, a causa dera sua valor istorica e culturau unica, e es prètzi des sues proprietats son des mès nautes deth país.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre (Cinc tèrres) compren es cinc petiti pòbles costèrs de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza e Monterosso, que se tròben en Ligúria, Itàlia.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Formen part deth listrat des Patrimònis dera Umanitat dera Unesco.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Damb eth pas des sègles, es persones an bastit damb suenh hilères de cases en paisatges irregulars e arribents, enquiàs malhs damb vista ara mar.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Part deth sòn atractiu ei era manca dera construccion per part der òme. I a camins, trèns e vaishèths que junhen es pòbles e es veïculs non i pòden accedir.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Es variantes deth francés parlat en Belgica e Soïssa son leugèrament diferentes ath francés que s'emplegue en França; totun, se tracte de variantes fòrça similares, de manèra que son mutuaument intelligibles.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: En particular, eth sistèma de numeracion des territòris francofòns de Belgica e Soïssa a leugères particularitats que lo hèn diferent deth francés que se parle en França e era prononciacion de quauqui mots ei un shinhau diferenta.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Totun, toti es bèlgues e soïssi francofòns aurien aprenut eth francés ena escòla, per tant, poderien comprené'c enquia se s'utilizèsse eth sistèma de numeracion deth francés estandard.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: En fòrça lòcs deth mon, saludar damb era man ei un gèst amistós que signifique «òla».
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Maugrat açò, en Malàisia, aumens entre es qui viuen en airaus ruraus, signifique «vene entad aciu», similar ath dit indicaire que se doble en tot dirigir-se cap ath pròpri còs, un gèst que s'utilize en cèrti païsi occidentaus; sonque aurie d'usar-se damb aguesta intencion.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: De forma similara, un viatgèr britanic que visite Espanha poderie confóner un gèst de comiat que consistís en orientar era pauma dera man en tot campar ar emissor (en lòc dera persona qu'arrecep era salutacion) coma un gèst entà tornar entà darrèr.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Es lenguatges auxiliars son lenguatges artificiaus o bastidi, creadi damb era fin de facilitar era comunicacion entre persones que, de ua auta forma, aurien problèmes entà comunicar-se.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Se diferéncien des lengües franques, que son aqueres naturaus o organiques que, per diuèrsi motius, se tornen dominantes coma estrument de comunicacion entre parlants de d’autes lengües.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Pendent era calor diürna, ei possible qu'es toristes veiguen miratges que genèren era illusion de visualizar aigua, entre d'auti.
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Aguesti pòden èster perilhosi s'eth viatgèr seguís eth miratge, en tot desaprofitar energia valuosa e era aigua restant.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Enquiàs desèrts mès cauds pòden tornar-se dramaticament heireds pendent era net. Era ipotermia ei un risc reau sense ròba d'abric.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Se deciditz hèr ua caminada pera sèuva tropicau, auratz de vigilar damb es mosquits, sustot pendent er ostiu.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Encara que condusisques pera sèuva subtropicau, damb uns pòqui segons damb es pòrtes dubèrtes mentre entres en coche, n'i a pro tà qu'es mosquits pugen damb tu.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Era gripa des audèths, aperada damb major formalitat gripa aviària, pòt afectar a audèths e mamifèrs.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Encara que s'an enregistrat mens de mil cassi en persones, quauqu'ns d'aguesti aueren un resultat fatau.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Era majoria des afectadi auien contacte damb audèths de corrau enes sòns trabalhs, mès tanben existís cèrt risc entàs observaires d'audèths.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: En Norvègia son tipics es fiòrds arribents e vals que de patac dan pas a un altiplan, mès o mens naut.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Aguesti altiplans sòlen cridar-se “vidde”, tèrme que signifique espaci ample e daurit sense arbes; ei díder, ua extension illimitada.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ei comun qu'en Rogaland e Agder se les cride “hei”, que vò díder lana sense arbes e soent corbida de bruga.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Es glacièrs non son estables, senon que fluïssen montanha tà baish, çò qu'origine henedures o henerècles que poderien demorar amagades per pònts de nhèu.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Ei possible qu'es murs e es tets des tutes de gèu s'enfonsen, e poderie èster qu'es henedures se barrèssen.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Immensi blòcs se desprenen e quèn des aurères des glacièrs e, a viatges, sauten o ròden mès luenh dera aurèra.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Enes estacions de montanha dera Índia, era sason nauta de toristes, per çò d'abituau, arribe ath sòn punt mès naut pendent er ostiu.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: De totes formes, an un tipe de beresa e atractiu especiau en epòca iuernau, quan moltes estacions de montanha arreceben granes quantitats de nhèu, en tot hèr possible era practica d'espòrts coma er esquí o er snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Es aerolinhes qu'encara aufrissen tarifes per dò son fòrça pòques e descompden un shinhau eth còst des viatges funeraris de darrèr moment.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Es companhies aerianes que les aufrissen son Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa, entà vòls damb origina enes EE. UU.  o en Canadà, e WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: En quinsevolh cas, auetz de reservar per telefon dirèctament damb era aerolinha.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
